units.title: Kata Sifat dan Kata Ganti Posesif; Whose

grammar.summary: Kata sifat posesif (Possessive Adjectives) digunakan sebelum kata benda untuk menyatakan kepemilikan. Sedangkan kata ganti posesif (Possessive Pronouns) berdiri sendiri menggantikan kata benda tersebut.

tables.title: Tabel Kata Sifat & Kata Ganti Posesif
rows: This is my moped. It's mine.
This is his camera. It's his.
These are our seats. They're ours.
Are these your pencils? Are they yours?
Those are their coats. They're theirs.

rules: Kata sifat posesif SELALU diletakkan sebelum kata benda: 'This is my sister\'s tablet.'
Kata ganti posesif berdiri sendiri dan TIDAK diikuti kata benda: 'That\'s her mobile. = It\'s hers.'
Gunakan 'whose' untuk menanyakan kepemilikan: 'Whose bag is this? It\'s mine.'
Ingat! Jangan tertukar antara 'whose' (milik siapa) dengan 'who\'s' (= who is atau who has).

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Lengkapi dengan Kata Ganti Posesif (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata ganti posesif yang tepat pada bagian yang kosong sesuai kepemilikan.

questions.q: 2. It's his hat. It's [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Bentuk kata sifat dan kata ganti posesif untuk he adalah 'his'.

questions.q: 3. It's her T-shirt. It's [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Kata sifat 'her' menjadi 'hers' saat berdiri sendiri.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Garis Bawahi Bentuk Posesif yang Tepat
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk kata sifat atau kata ganti posesif yang benar sesuai konteks kalimat.

questions.q: 1. This coat isn't [BLANK], it's too small. It must be [BLANK2].
questions.hint: Keduanya berdiri sendiri tanpa kata benda.
questions.explanation: Gunakan kata ganti posesif 'mine' dan 'yours' karena tidak diikuti kata benda.

questions.q: 2. Tell Lisa not to forget [BLANK] passport and not to forget [BLANK2] either.
questions.hint: Passport adalah kata benda, di akhir berdiri sendiri.
questions.explanation: 'her' mendampingi kata benda 'passport', sedangkan 'mine' menggantikan 'my passport'.

questions.q: 3. I don't have any drink left. Can I have some of [BLANK]?
questions.hint: Berdiri sendiri di akhir kalimat tanya.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'yours' karena bermakna 'your drink' tanpa mengulang kata 'drink'.

questions.q: 4. This doesn't look like [BLANK] jacket.
questions.explanation: Sebelum kata benda 'jacket', kita wajib menggunakan kata sifat posesif 'my'.

questions.q: 5. Two of [BLANK] children go to junior school and [BLANK2] oldest son goes to secondary school.
questions.hint: Keduanya diikuti kata benda: 'children' dan 'oldest son'.
questions.explanation: Keduanya membutuhkan kata sifat posesif 'their'.

questions.q: 6. You can take [BLANK] keys if you can't find [BLANK2].
questions.hint: Pertama ada kata 'keys', kedua berdiri sendiri.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'my keys' (adjective) dan 'yours' (pronoun).

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Lengkapi dengan Kata Sifat Posesif (my, your, his, her, its, our, their)
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata sifat posesif yang tepat untuk melengkapi kalimat sebelum kata benda.

questions.q: 1. Why don't you ask Sam to lend us [BLANK] car?
questions.explanation: Sam (laki-laki) menggunakan possessive adjective 'his'.

questions.q: 2. The children washed [BLANK] hands and walked into the kitchen.
questions.explanation: The children adalah subjek jamak (they), kata sifat posesifnya adalah 'their'.

questions.q: 3. My sister goes on [BLANK] favourite social network website every day.
questions.explanation: My sister (she) menggunakan 'her'.

questions.q: 4. Put [BLANK] jumper on. The weather is quite chilly today.
questions.explanation: Bentuk perintah kepada orang kedua memakai 'your jumper'.

questions.q: 5. My parents and older brother came to [BLANK] graduation.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'my' untuk menyatakan wisuda milik penutur.

questions.q: 6. Tom and Nancy just returned back from [BLANK] holiday.
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak orang ketiga memakai 'their'.

questions.q: 7. Amy fell and twisted [BLANK] ankle.
questions.explanation: Amy (perempuan) menggunakan 'her ankle'.

questions.q: 8. Jenny and [BLANK] boyfriend came to the cinema with us.
questions.explanation: Jenny adalah perempuan, pacarnya disebut 'her boyfriend'.

questions.q: 9. Sam has got a new puppy. [BLANK] name is Spot.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'its' (tanpa petik atas) untuk hewan.

questions.q: 10. Andrew needs new glasses because [BLANK] old ones are broken.
questions.explanation: Andrew (he) memakai 'his old ones'.

questions.q: 11. A: What's the name of the boy who is sitting next to Lexi? B: [BLANK] name is Robert.
questions.explanation: The boy adalah laki-laki, maka gunakan 'his name'.

questions.q: 12. [BLANK] car is old, but we still like it.
questions.explanation: Karena menyatakan 'we still like it', maka mobil itu adalah milik kami ('Our car').

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Lengkapi Percakapan dengan Kata Ganti Posesif
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata ganti posesif (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs) yang tepat pada percakapan.

questions.q: 3. That's her house and the motorbike over there is [BLANK], too.

questions.explanation: Gunakan 'hers' menggantikan 'her motorbike'.

questions.q: 5. A: Is this his scarf? B: No, [BLANK] is brown.

questions.q: 6. Paul, this is my plate and that's [BLANK].

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Lengkapi Kalimat dengan Kata Sifat Posesif
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat dengan kata sifat posesif (my, your, his, her, its, our, their) yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Hello! My name is Simon and this is [BLANK] sister.
questions.explanation: Simon memperkenalkan saudarinya: 'my sister'.

questions.q: 2. That's Mrs Clark. [BLANK] first name is Linda.
questions.explanation: Mrs Clark adalah perempuan, nama depannya adalah 'Her first name'.

questions.q: 3. That girl is very nice and [BLANK] brother is nice too.
questions.explanation: That girl (perempuan) menggunakan 'her brother'.

questions.q: 4. We're Nicole and Mark and this is [BLANK] friend John.
questions.explanation: Nicole and Mark (kami/we) menggunakan 'our friend'.

questions.q: 5. They're French, but [BLANK] father is German.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'they' memiliki ayah: 'their father'.

questions.q: 6. Look at that car. One of [BLANK] tyres is flat.
questions.explanation: Car adalah benda mati tunggal (it), bannya adalah 'its tyres'.

questions.q: 7. I'm on a school trip with [BLANK] science class and teacher.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' menggunakan 'my science class'.

questions.q: 8. Poor Mary! [BLANK] mother is ill in hospital.
questions.explanation: Mary adalah perempuan, jadi ibunya adalah 'Her mother'.

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Pertanyaan dan Jawaban Kepemilikan (Whose)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah pasangan pertanyaan dan jawaban kepemilikan yang tepat sesuai kata kunci.

questions.q: 1. Whose / these red socks / be? (I)
options: A: Whose red socks are these? B: They are mine.
A: Whose red socks is this? B: It is my.
A: Who's red socks are these? B: They are me.
questions.answer: A: Whose red socks are these? B: They are mine.
questions.hint: Socks adalah jamak (are these) dan kepemilikan orang pertama (mine).
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Whose red socks are these?' dan jawaban kata ganti posesif 'They are mine'.

questions.q: 2. Whose / this book / be? (you)
options: A: Whose book is this? B: It is yours.
A: Whose book are these? B: They are yours.
A: Who's book is this? B: It is your.
questions.answer: A: Whose book is this? B: It is yours.
questions.hint: Book adalah tunggal (is this) dan kepemilikan orang kedua (yours).
questions.explanation: 'Whose book is this?' dijawab dengan 'It is yours'.

questions.q: 3. Whose / this medicine / be? (they)
options: A: Whose medicine is this? B: It is theirs.
A: Whose medicine are these? B: They are their.
A: Who's medicine is this? B: It is them.
questions.answer: A: Whose medicine is this? B: It is theirs.
questions.hint: Medicine adalah uncountable/tunggal (is this) dan kepemilikan mereka (theirs).
questions.explanation: 'Whose medicine is this?' dijawab dengan 'It is theirs'.

questions.q: 4. Whose / this MP3 player / be? (she)
options: A: Whose MP3 player is this? B: It is hers.
A: Whose MP3 player are these? B: It is her.
A: Who's MP3 player is this? B: They are hers.
questions.answer: A: Whose MP3 player is this? B: It is hers.
questions.hint: MP3 player tunggal, kepunyaan dia perempuan (hers).
questions.explanation: 'Whose MP3 player is this?' dijawab dengan 'It is hers'.

questions.q: 5. Whose / this umbrella / be? (we)
options: A: Whose umbrella is this? B: It is ours.
A: Whose umbrella are these? B: It is our.
A: Who's umbrella is this? B: They are ours.
questions.answer: A: Whose umbrella is this? B: It is ours.
questions.explanation: 'Whose umbrella is this?' dijawab dengan 'It is ours'.

questions.q: 6. Whose / that digital camera / be? (I)
options: A: Whose digital camera is that? B: It is mine.
A: Whose digital camera are those? B: They are my.
A: Who's digital camera is that? B: It is me.
questions.answer: A: Whose digital camera is that? B: It is mine.
questions.hint: That digital camera tunggal, kepemilikan saya (mine).
questions.explanation: 'Whose digital camera is that?' dijawab dengan 'It is mine'.

questions.q: 7. Whose / these jeans / be? (he)
options: A: Whose jeans are these? B: They are his.
A: Whose jeans is this? B: It is his.
A: Who's jeans are these? B: They are him.
questions.answer: A: Whose jeans are these? B: They are his.
questions.hint: Jeans selalu berbentuk jamak (are these), kepemilikan dia laki-laki (his).
questions.explanation: Jeans selalu jamak, dijawab dengan 'They are his'.

questions.q: 8. Whose / these parents / be? (your)
options: A: Whose parents are these? B: They are ours.
A: Whose parents is this? B: It is ours.
A: Who's parents are these? B: They are your.
questions.answer: A: Whose parents are these? B: They are ours.
questions.explanation: 'Whose parents are these?' dijawab dengan 'They are ours'.

units.title: Penggunaan have, can, dan could
units.english_title: Usage of have, can, and could

grammar.summary: Kata kerja 'have' sering digunakan dalam kolokasi kegiatan sehari-hari. 'Can' digunakan untuk menyatakan kemampuan, meminta izin, atau kemungkinan di masa sekarang. 'Could' digunakan untuk kemampuan di masa lampau dan permintaan yang lebih sopan.

tables.title: Kolokasi Umum Menggunakan have
rows: I had a strange dream last night.

tables.title: Penggunaan can dan could
rows: You can buy sun cream here.
He could swim when he was 8.
Could you pass the salt, please?

rules: Jangan tertukar antara 'have' (kegiatan) dengan 'have got' (kepemilikan fisik). Bentuk negatif 'have' menggunakan don't/doesn't/didn't: 'She doesn't have a shower in the morning.'
'can' dan 'could' TIDAK pernah berubah bentuk (tidak ada 'cans' atau 'coulds').
'can' dan 'could' langsung diikuti oleh kata kerja dasar (infinitive without to): 'I can sing.' (BUKAN 'I can to sing').

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Pilihan Kolokasi have yang Tepat (Hal 6)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah jawaban a, b, atau c yang membentuk kolokasi yang benar dengan have.

questions.q: 1. I usually have [BLANK] every morning before I go to school.

questions.q: 5. I hope Tom has [BLANK] on the plane. The weather is quite windy today.
questions.explanation: Penerbangan yang menyenangkan dan lancar adalah 'have a good flight'.

questions.q: 6. Anna and I are having [BLANK] at the new Greek restaurant tonight.

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Lengkapi Kalimat dengan Ungkapan have (Hal 7)
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk have yang tepat (have a bath, have a nice meal, have a party, have a good flight, have a chat, have a look, have a good time, have a swim, have a rest, have a snack).

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Buat Pertanyaan dan Jawaban dengan can (Hal 8)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah pasangan pertanyaan dan jawaban permintaan izin (can) yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. have a snack
options: A: Can I have a snack? B: Yes, you can.
A: Could I having a snack? B: Yes, you can.
A: Can I have a snack? B: No, you don't.
questions.answer: A: Can I have a snack? B: Yes, you can.
questions.explanation: Permintaan izin: 'Can I have a snack?' dijawab 'Yes, you can'.

questions.q: 2. have another piece of cake
options: A: Can I have another piece of cake? B: Yes, you can.
A: Can I having another cake? B: Yes, I can.
A: Can you have another piece of cake? B: Yes, you could.
questions.answer: A: Can I have another piece of cake? B: Yes, you can.
questions.explanation: 'Can I have another piece of cake?' dijawab 'Yes, you can'.

questions.q: 3. come tomorrow
options: A: Can you come tomorrow? B: Yes, I can.
A: Could you came tomorrow? B: Yes, I can.
A: Can you coming tomorrow? B: No, I can.
questions.answer: A: Can you come tomorrow? B: Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 'Can you come tomorrow?' dijawab 'Yes, I can.'

questions.q: 4. use your mobile
options: A: Can I use your mobile? B: Yes, of course you can.
A: Could I using your mobile? B: Yes, I do.
A: Can I used your mobile? B: No, you couldn't.
questions.answer: A: Can I use your mobile? B: Yes, of course you can.
questions.explanation: Meminta izin memakai ponsel: 'Can I use your mobile?'.

questions.q: 5. go away this weekend with my friends
options: A: Can I go away this weekend with my friends? B: Yes, you can.
A: Can you go away with friends? B: Yes, I could.
A: Could I went away this weekend? B: No, you don't.
questions.answer: A: Can I go away this weekend with my friends? B: Yes, you can.
questions.explanation: 'Can I go away this weekend with my friends?' dijawab 'Yes, you can.'

questions.q: 6. walk to school with you
options: A: Can I walk to school with you? B: Yes, of course.
A: Could I walked to school with you? B: Yes, I walk.
A: Can I walking to school with you? B: Yes, you can.
questions.answer: A: Can I walk to school with you? B: Yes, of course.
questions.explanation: 'Can I walk to school with you?' dijawab 'Yes, of course.'

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Lengkapi dengan can atau can't (Hal 8)
exercises.instruction: Ketik can atau can't sesuai makna dan konteks kalimat.

questions.q: 1. I'm sorry, I [BLANK] speak Chinese!
questions.hint: Maaf, saya tidak bisa berbicara bahasa Mandarin.
questions.explanation: Permintaan maaf mengindikasikan ketidakmampuan: 'can't'.

questions.q: 2. I [BLANK] understand a word of what he is saying.
questions.hint: Saya tidak bisa paham satu kata pun.
questions.explanation: 'can't understand a word' bermakna sama sekali tidak paham.

questions.q: 3. I [BLANK] play the guitar, but I can't play the piano very well.
questions.hint: Saya bisa main gitar, TETAPI tidak bisa main piano.
questions.explanation: Kata hubung kontras 'but' mengindikasikan bagian pertama bermakna positif: 'can'.

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] you tell me the time, please?
questions.hint: Bisakah kamu memberi tahu saya jam berapa sekarang?
questions.explanation: Permintaan sopan: 'Can you tell me the time, please?'.

questions.q: 5. [BLANK] you help me with my heavy suitcase, please?
questions.hint: Bisakah kamu membantu saya membawakan koper berat ini?
questions.explanation: Permintaan bantuan: 'Can you help me...?'.

questions.q: 6. Why [BLANK] you come to the café with us?
questions.hint: Kenapa kamu tidak bisa ikut ke kafe bersama kami?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan alasan tidak ikut: 'Why can't you come...?'.

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Pilihan Tepat can vs could (Hal 8)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk modal yang tepat antara masa kini (can/can't) atau masa lalu (could/couldn't).

questions.q: 1. Look Mum! I [BLANK] play the guitar.
questions.explanation: Tindakan yang sedang ditunjukkan saat ini memakai 'can'.

questions.q: 2. He looked all over the house, but he [BLANK] find his watch.
questions.explanation: Karena kalimat berbentuk past tense ('looked'), maka gunakan 'couldn't'.

questions.q: 3. [BLANK] you speak French when you were in primary school?
questions.hint: Perhatikan klausa 'when you were in primary school' (masa lalu)
questions.explanation: Kemampuan di masa lalu ('when you were') menuntut penggunaan 'Could'.

questions.q: 4. Megan [BLANK] go out when she finishes her homework.
questions.explanation: Megan diperbolehkan pergi saat menyelesaikan PR: 'can go out'.

questions.q: 5. The T-shirt was wet so the boy [BLANK] wear it.
questions.explanation: Bentuk lampau 'was wet' berpasangan dengan 'couldn't'.

questions.q: 6. My father [BLANK] drive when he was 16.
questions.explanation: Kemampuan masa lalu saat berusia 16 tahun memakai 'could'.

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Lengkapi dengan can, can't, could, atau couldn't
exercises.instruction: Ketik can, can't, could, atau couldn't sesuai konteks tenses kalimat.

questions.q: 1. We [BLANK] hire a car and take a tour of the city. What do you think?
questions.explanation: Memberi usulan masa kini: 'We can hire a car...'.

questions.q: 2. They [BLANK] get on the bus. They haven't got tickets.
questions.hint: Masa kini: mereka tidak punya tiket sekarang
questions.explanation: Tidak punya tiket saat ini: 'can't get on the bus'.

questions.q: 3. You [BLANK] borrow my computer. I don't need it at the moment.
questions.explanation: Memberikan izin saat ini: 'You can borrow my computer'.

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] you ride a bike when you were five?
questions.explanation: Kemampuan di masa kecil (when you were five) memakai 'Could'.

questions.q: 5. The car park was full and I [BLANK] find a parking space.
questions.explanation: Bentuk lampau (was full) memakai 'couldn't'.

questions.q: 6. We don't have any Internet connection, so I [BLANK] check my emails.
questions.explanation: Kondisi masa kini (don't have) memakai 'can't'.

exercises.title: Latihan 11: Respons Situasi dengan can atau can't (Hal 9)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah ungkapan usulan (can) atau ketidakmungkinan (can't) yang tepat sesuai situasi.

questions.q: 1. It's a sunny day. (go out for a walk)
options: We can go out for a walk.
We can't go out for a walk.
Can we went for a walk?
questions.answer: We can go out for a walk.
questions.explanation: Cuaca cerah memungkinkan kita jalan-jalan: 'We can go out for a walk.'

questions.q: 2. There's a public transport strike. (go to work by car)
options: We can go to work by car.
We can't go to work by car.
questions.answer: We can go to work by car.
questions.hint: Angkutan umum mogok, alternatifnya naik mobil
questions.explanation: Sebagai solusi alternatif: 'We can go to work by car.'

questions.q: 3. Tina is very ill today. (come to work)
questions.hint: Sakit parah, tidak bisa masuk kerja
questions.explanation: Sakit parah mengakibatkan tidak bisa bekerja: 'She can't come to work.'

questions.q: 4. This place is very noisy. (you / speak louder)
questions.hint: Tempat bising, tolong bicara lebih keras
questions.explanation: Meminta lawan bicara bersuara lebih keras: 'Can you speak louder?'.

questions.q: 5. Mr Wilkins is very busy at the moment. (see you now)
questions.hint: Sedang sangat sibuk, tidak bisa menemui
questions.explanation: Sangat sibuk saat ini: 'He can't see you now.'

questions.q: 6. My car broke down. (you / give me a ride)
options: Can you give me a ride?
Can I give you a ride?
You can give me a ride.
questions.answer: Can you give me a ride?
questions.explanation: Meminta bantuan tumpangan: 'Can you give me a ride?'.

questions.q: 7. I left my umbrella in the taxi. (borrow yours)
questions.explanation: Meminjam payung teman: 'Can I borrow yours?'.

questions.q: 8. The girl over there is crying. (help her)
questions.hint: Anak gadis itu menangis, bisakah kita menolongnya
questions.explanation: Menawarkan bantuan: 'Can we help her?'.

questions.q: 9. I have no money. (lend me some)
questions.hint: Tidak punya uang, bisakah meminjamkan saya sedikit
questions.explanation: Meminta pinjaman uang: 'Can you lend me some?'.

questions.q: 10. The roads are very icy from the snow. (use our bike today)
options: We can't use our bike today.
We can use our bike today.
Can we used our bike today?
questions.answer: We can't use our bike today.
questions.hint: Jalanan licin tertutup es, tidak bisa naik sepeda
questions.explanation: Jalanan licin bersalju berbahaya: 'We can't use our bike today.'

exercises.title: Latihan 12: Pemahaman Bacaan Teks 'ABOUT ME: Graham' (Hal 9)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah jawaban yang paling tepat berdasarkan teks profil Graham pada halaman 9.

questions.q: 1. When does Graham have breakfast everyday?
questions.hint: Cari jam sarapan pada paragraf pertama.
questions.explanation: Teks menyatakan: 'I usually get up and feed the dog, and then have breakfast at 6:45.'

questions.q: 2. What does Graham do after breakfast?
options: He has a shower, gets dressed and leaves for school.
He plays the guitar and rides his horse.
He feeds the dog and swims.
questions.answer: He has a shower, gets dressed and leaves for school.
questions.explanation: Teks: 'I have a shower at around 7:30 a.m and then I get dressed and leave for school at about 8:00 a.m.'

questions.q: 3. What hobbies and sport does he say he can do?
options: He can play the guitar, ride a horse, and play football.
He can scuba dive, play piano, and play tennis.
He can play chess and sing.
questions.answer: He can play the guitar, ride a horse, and play football.
questions.hint: Keahlian musik dan olahraga yang ia sebutkan.
questions.explanation: Teks: 'I can play the guitar and I can also ride a horse too. I can play football really well.'

questions.q: 4. What couldn't he do when he was a child?
questions.explanation: Teks: 'When I was younger, I couldn't swim very well, but now I'm an excellent swimmer.'

questions.q: 5. Where do Graham and his family usually have a holiday?
options: In a country where they can scuba dive.
In a big city with shopping malls.
questions.answer: In a country where they can scuba dive.
questions.explanation: Teks: 'Every year we usually have a two-week family holiday in a country where we can scuba dive.'

questions.q: 6. What does he say about his holiday in Australia?
options: They went to The Great Barrier Reef and it was amazing.
He got sick and couldn't swim.
questions.answer: They went to The Great Barrier Reef and it was amazing.
questions.explanation: Teks: 'Last year, we went to The Great Barrier Reef in Australia. We had a really good time. It was amazing!'

grammar.summary: Pola kalimat untuk mengajak seseorang melakukan kegiatan bersama, serta cara merespons ajakan tersebut dengan menerima atau menolak secara sopan.

tables.title: Ungkapan Mengajak, Menerima, dan Menolak
rows: Yes, I'd love to! / That sounds great!
I'm sorry, I can't. I have to study.
I'd rather not. I'm really tired.
Thanks for asking, but I have other plans.

rules: 'Would you like to' dan 'Why don't we' selalu diikuti kata kerja dasar (infinitive): 'Would you like to go to the cinema?'
'How about' dan 'What about' SELALU diikuti oleh bentuk kata kerja -ing atau kata benda: 'How about having pizza?'
Saat menolak ajakan dalam bahasa Inggris, biasakan selalu diawali permohonan maaf dan alasan yang masuk akal agar tetap sopan.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Rangkai Kata Menjadi Kalimat Ajakan (Hal 10)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah susunan kalimat ajakan yang benar dan gramatikal dari kata-kata acak.

questions.q: 1. the / go / to / tonight / theatre / let's / !
options: Let's go to the theatre tonight!
Tonight let's the theatre go to!
questions.answer: Let's go to the theatre tonight!
questions.explanation: Rumus: Let's + infinitif tanpa to ('go') + to the theatre tonight!

questions.q: 2. about / for / how / at / out / going / the weekend / a meal / ?
options: How about going out for a meal at the weekend?
How about at the weekend going out for meal?
How going out for about a meal at weekend?
questions.answer: How about going out for a meal at the weekend?
questions.explanation: Rumus: How about + verb-ing ('going') + out for a meal at the weekend?

questions.q: 3. swimming / you / to / go / would / this afternoon / like / ?
options: Would you like to go swimming this afternoon?
Would like you to go swimming this afternoon?
You would like to go swimming this afternoon?
questions.answer: Would you like to go swimming this afternoon?
questions.explanation: Rumus: Would you like to go swimming this afternoon?

questions.q: 4. listen / we / some / to / don't / why / music / ?
options: Why don't we listen to some music?
Why we don't listen to some music?
Why don't listen we some music to?
questions.answer: Why don't we listen to some music?
questions.explanation: Rumus ajakan: Why don't we listen to some music?

questions.q: 5. holidays / you / like / to / what / over / the / would / summer / do / ?
options: What would you like to do over the summer holidays?
What you would like to do over the summer holidays?
Would you like what to do over summer holidays?
questions.answer: What would you like to do over the summer holidays?
questions.hint: What would you like to do...
questions.explanation: Rumus pertanyaan: What would you like to do over the summer holidays?

questions.q: 6. this evening / we / a / pizza / shall / for / order / dinner / ?
options: Shall we order a pizza for dinner this evening?
Shall we a pizza order for dinner this evening?
We shall order a pizza for dinner this evening?
questions.answer: Shall we order a pizza for dinner this evening?
questions.explanation: Rumus usulan sopan: Shall we order a pizza for dinner this evening?

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Mengajak dan Menolak dengan Alasan (Hal 11)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah pasangan ungkapan ajakan dan respons penolakan yang santun disertai alasan.

questions.q: 1. rent a DVD tonight / am going out with my parents
options: A: Let's rent a DVD tonight. B: Sorry, I can't. I'm going out with my parents tonight.
A: Shall we rent DVD? B: No, I don't want.
A: Let's renting a DVD. B: I can't rent.
questions.answer: A: Let's rent a DVD tonight. B: Sorry, I can't. I'm going out with my parents tonight.
questions.explanation: Ajakan 'Let's rent a DVD tonight' ditolak dengan sopan: 'Sorry, I can't. I'm going out with my parents tonight.'

questions.q: 2. come with us to the mountains this weekend / must study for exams
options: A: Would you like to come with us to the mountains this weekend? B: Sorry, I can't. I must study for exams.
A: You come to mountains? B: No, study exams.
A: Shall you coming to mountains? B: I must study.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to come with us to the mountains this weekend? B: Sorry, I can't. I must study for exams.
questions.hint: Would you like to come... / Sorry, I can't...
questions.explanation: Ajakan santun: 'Would you like to come with us...?' dijawab alasan ujian.

questions.q: 3. play tennis on Sunday morning / go to church
options: A: Shall we play tennis on Sunday morning? B: Sorry, I can't. I have to go to church.
A: Let's playing tennis Sunday. B: No church.
A: Why we don't play tennis? B: I go to church.
questions.answer: A: Shall we play tennis on Sunday morning? B: Sorry, I can't. I have to go to church.
questions.hint: Shall we play... / I have to go to church
questions.explanation: 'Shall we play tennis on Sunday morning?' ditolak dengan alasan ke gereja.

questions.q: 4. come to my house after school / must go to the dentist's
options: A: Why don't you come to my house after school? B: Sorry, I can't. I must go to the dentist's.
A: Why you don't come home? B: Dentist.
A: Let's coming to my house. B: No dentist.
questions.answer: A: Why don't you come to my house after school? B: Sorry, I can't. I must go to the dentist's.
questions.explanation: 'Why don't you come to my house after school?' ditolak karena harus ke dokter gigi.

questions.q: 5. go to the music festival / haven't got any tickets
options: A: How about going to the music festival? B: I'd love to, but I haven't got any tickets.
A: How about go to music festival? B: No ticket.
A: Shall we going to festival? B: I don't ticket.
questions.answer: A: How about going to the music festival? B: I'd love to, but I haven't got any tickets.
questions.hint: How about going... / haven't got any tickets
questions.explanation: 'How about going to the music festival?' ditolak karena tidak punya tiket.

questions.q: 6. call him now / must do the cleaning up now
options: A: Shall we call him now? B: Not now, I must do the cleaning up now.
A: Let's calling him now. B: No cleaning.
A: Why don't we to call him? B: I clean.
questions.answer: A: Shall we call him now? B: Not now, I must do the cleaning up now.
questions.explanation: 'Shall we call him now?' ditanggapi karena harus bersih-bersih.

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Dengarkan Rekaman TR 3 dan Pilih Respons Tepat (Hal 11)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah respons yang tepat untuk setiap usulan atau pertanyaan pada rekaman audio TR 3.

questions.q: 1. Would you like to go to the cinema?
options: b. No, I'd rather go bowling.
questions.answer: b. No, I'd rather go bowling.
questions.explanation: Respons penolakan sopan dengan preferensi alternatif memakai 'I'd rather'.

questions.q: 2. Let's have a picnic. It's a beautiful day.
questions.explanation: Menerima ajakan piknik: 'That's a great idea!'.

questions.q: 3. What would you like to do at the weekend?
options: b. Yes, I'm free at the weekend.
questions.explanation: Menjawab pertanyaan rencana akhir pekan dengan mengusulkan: 'Let's go swimming.'

questions.q: 4. How about we go for coffee?
questions.explanation: Persetujuan santai: 'Yes, OK.'

questions.q: 5. Why don't we go to the beach?
options: a. I don't know. Why don't we?
b. That sounds like a good idea.
questions.answer: b. That sounds like a good idea.
questions.explanation: Menerima usulan ke pantai: 'That sounds like a good idea.'

questions.q: 6. How would you like your steak cooked?
options: b. I'd like it well done, please.
questions.answer: b. I'd like it well done, please.
questions.explanation: Menjawab tingkat kematangan daging: 'I'd like it well done, please.'

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Buat Kalimat dengan like atau would like (Hal 12)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat yang tepat antara menyatakan kesukaan umum (like) atau keinginan spesifik (would like).

questions.q: 1. Jane has all the Coldplay albums.
questions.explanation: Memiliki semua album membuktikan ia suka (likes) band tersebut.

questions.q: 2. Peter has more than twenty cookbooks.
questions.explanation: Punya lebih dari 20 buku resep menunjukkan ia suka memasak ('likes cooking').

questions.q: 3. My car is ten years old!
options: I would like a new car.
questions.answer: I would like a new car.
questions.explanation: Mobilnya sudah 10 tahun, jadi ia menginginkan mobil baru ('would like a new car').

questions.q: 4. Cathy thinks her house is very small.
options: She would like a bigger house.
questions.answer: She would like a bigger house.
questions.explanation: Rumahnya sempit, ia ingin rumah yang lebih besar ('would like a bigger house').

questions.q: 5. My children have four cats, three dogs, and a bird.
questions.explanation: Punya banyak hewan peliharaan menunjukkan mereka suka hewan ('like animals').

questions.q: 6. There's a good film on TV tonight.
options: I would like to watch it.
questions.answer: I would like to watch it.
questions.explanation: Keinginan spesifik malam ini memakai 'would like to watch it'.

questions.q: 7. Simon buys a lot of music from the Internet.
questions.explanation: Membeli banyak musik menunjukkan ia suka musik ('likes music').

questions.q: 8. I don't want to go out tonight.
options: I would like to stay at home.
I like to stay at home.
questions.answer: I would like to stay at home.
questions.hint: Keinginan berada di rumah malam ini
questions.explanation: Pilihan spesifik malam ini memakai 'would like to stay at home'.

questions.q: 9. Tom and Lisa always have a winter holiday.
questions.explanation: Kebiasaan rutin liburan musim dingin: 'They like skiing'.

questions.q: 10. Lucy wants to try Japanese food at the new restaurant in town.
options: She would like to eat sushi.
questions.answer: She would like to eat sushi.
questions.explanation: Keinginan mencoba makanan baru: 'She would like to eat sushi'.

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Ajak Teman dengan would you like to... Menerima Ajakan (Hal 12)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah pasangan ajakan dan penerimaan ajakan yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. watch a sci-fi film
options: A: Would you like to watch a sci-fi film? B: Yes, I'd love to.
A: Do you like watch sci-fi film? B: Yes, I like.
A: Would you like watching a film? B: No, I don't.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to watch a sci-fi film? B: Yes, I'd love to.
questions.hint: Would you like to watch... / Yes, I'd love to.
questions.explanation: Ajakan sopan memakai 'Would you like to watch...?' dan diterima dengan 'Yes, I'd love to.'

questions.q: 2. order a takeaway
options: A: Would you like to order a takeaway? B: Yes, that sounds great.
A: Do you like ordering takeaway? B: Yes, I order.
A: Would you liking a takeaway? B: Yes, I do.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to order a takeaway? B: Yes, that sounds great.
questions.hint: Would you like to order... / Yes, that sounds great.
questions.explanation: 'Would you like to order a takeaway?' dijawab 'Yes, that sounds great.'

questions.q: 3. listen to music
options: A: Would you like to listen to music? B: Yes, I'd love to.
A: Do you listen to music? B: Yes, I listen.
A: Would you like listening music? B: Yes, I would.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to listen to music? B: Yes, I'd love to.
questions.hint: Would you like to listen... / Yes, I'd love to.
questions.explanation: 'Would you like to listen to music?' dijawab 'Yes, I'd love to.'

questions.q: 4. go shopping with me next Saturday
options: A: Would you like to go shopping with me next Saturday? B: Yes, I'd love to.
A: Do you like go shopping next Saturday? B: Yes, I like.
A: Shall you go shopping with me? B: Yes, I do.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to go shopping with me next Saturday? B: Yes, I'd love to.
questions.hint: Would you like to go shopping... / Yes, I'd love to.
questions.explanation: 'Would you like to go shopping with me next Saturday?' diterima dengan antusias.

questions.q: 5. try my new car
options: A: Would you like to try my new car? B: Yes, please.
A: Do you like trying my car? B: Yes, I try.
A: Would you to try my car? B: Yes, I like.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to try my new car? B: Yes, please.
questions.hint: Would you like to try... / Yes, please.
questions.explanation: 'Would you like to try my new car?' dijawab sopan 'Yes, please.'

questions.q: 6. go ice skating this afternoon
options: A: Would you like to go ice skating this afternoon? B: Yes, that would be wonderful.
A: Do you like go ice skating? B: Yes, I do.
A: Would you like going ice skating? B: Yes, wonderful.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to go ice skating this afternoon? B: Yes, that would be wonderful.
questions.hint: Would you like to go ice skating... / that would be wonderful.
questions.explanation: 'Would you like to go ice skating this afternoon?' diterima dengan 'Yes, that would be wonderful.'

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Menolak & Memberi Alternatif dengan I'd rather (Hal 12)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah pasangan kalimat yang menolak ajakan dan memberikan usulan alternatif menggunakan I'd rather.

questions.q: 1. go to the cinema on Saturday afternoon / go to the cinema Saturday night
options: A: Would you like to go to the cinema on Saturday afternoon? B: I'd rather go on Saturday night.
A: Do you go to cinema Saturday? B: I prefer Saturday.
A: Shall we going Saturday afternoon? B: No Saturday.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to go to the cinema on Saturday afternoon? B: I'd rather go on Saturday night.
questions.explanation: Menolak dan memberi alternatif: 'I'd rather go on Saturday night.'

questions.q: 2. have a seat / stand up
options: A: Would you like to have a seat? B: I'd rather stand up.
A: Do you like sitting? B: I stand.
A: Would you like to sit? B: No, sitting.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to have a seat? B: I'd rather stand up.
questions.explanation: Menolak duduk dan memilih berdiri: 'I'd rather stand up.'

questions.q: 3. go skiing this weekend / go to the beach
options: A: Would you like to go skiing this weekend? B: I'd rather go to the beach.
A: Do you go skiing? B: Beach is better.
A: Let's skiing. B: I don't skiing.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to go skiing this weekend? B: I'd rather go to the beach.
questions.hint: I'd rather go to the beach.
questions.explanation: Memilih ke pantai daripada main ski: 'I'd rather go to the beach.'

questions.q: 4. travel by train / travel by bus
options: A: Would you like to travel by train? B: I'd rather travel by bus.
A: Do you like travel train? B: Bus please.
A: Shall we to travel by train? B: Rather bus.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to travel by train? B: I'd rather travel by bus.
questions.explanation: Memilih naik bus: 'I'd rather travel by bus.'

questions.q: 5. have something to eat / have something to drink
options: A: Would you like to have something to eat? B: I'd rather have something to drink.
A: Do you like eating? B: I drink.
A: Shall you eating? B: Rather drink.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to have something to eat? B: I'd rather have something to drink.
questions.hint: I'd rather have something to drink.
questions.explanation: Memilih minum daripada makan: 'I'd rather have something to drink.'

questions.q: 6. go for a walk / go for a bike ride
options: A: Would you like to go for a walk? B: I'd rather go for a bike ride.
A: Do you walk? B: I bike.
A: Let's walking. B: Rather biking.
questions.answer: A: Would you like to go for a walk? B: I'd rather go for a bike ride.
questions.hint: I'd rather go for a bike ride.

units.title: Bentuk Masa Depan: be going to

grammar.summary: Struktur 'be going to' digunakan untuk menyatakan rencana/niat yang telah diputuskan sebelum berbicara, serta untuk ramalan masa depan berdasarkan bukti nyata saat ini.

tables.title: Rumus be going to
rows: She is going to cut her hair tomorrow.
Subject + am/is/are + not + going to + V1
We are not going to travel by plane.
Are you going to visit your grandparents?

rules: Gunakan 'be going to' untuk rencana yang SUDAH diniatkan sebelumnya: 'I am going to buy a new laptop next month.'
Gunakan 'be going to' untuk prediksi dengan bukti yang terlihat jelas di depan mata: 'Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.'
Jangan lupa menyertakan to be (am/is/are) sebelum 'going to'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Melengkapi Kalimat dengan be going to dan Kata Kerja yang Sesuai
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk be going to dan kata kerja yang tepat (move, read, do, learn, stay, have, visit, reply, buy, rain).

questions.q: 1. A: Are you going to stay in Brighton with your parents after college? B: No, I [BLANK] to London with a friend. I'm so excited!
questions.hint: Subjek I + am + going to + move
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' menggunakan to be 'am' + going to + kata kerja 'move'.

questions.q: 2. When [BLANK] to Tom's email?
questions.hint: Kalimat tanya: When + are + you + going to + verb
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat tanya masa depan dengan subjek 'you': 'When are you going to reply...?'.

questions.q: 3. Joe [BLANK] to play the drums.
questions.explanation: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal 'Joe' memakai 'is going to learn'.

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] The Hunger Games book?
questions.hint: Pertanyaan untuk subjek she: Is + she + going to + read
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat tanya: 'Is she going to read...'.

questions.q: 5. A: What are you going to do now? B: I'm tired. I [BLANK] a rest.
questions.hint: Subjek I + am + going to have
questions.explanation: 'I am going to have a rest' menyatakan niat yang baru saja diputuskan karena lelah.

questions.q: 6. The Smiths [BLANK] a new flat.
questions.explanation: 'The Smiths' merujuk pada keluarga Smith (jamak), sehingga menggunakan 'are going to buy'.

questions.q: 7. [BLANK] your relatives in Paris this weekend?
questions.hint: Subjek you -> Are you going to visit
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat tanya: 'Are you going to visit...'.

questions.q: 8. Take your coat and your umbrella. It [BLANK] soon!
questions.hint: Bukti cuaca mendung/hujan -> It is going to rain
questions.explanation: Prediksi berdasarkan tanda atau bukti nyata saat ini menggunakan 'is going to rain'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Rencana Masa Depan (Afirmatif & Negatif be going to)
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat dengan bentuk be going to afirmatif atau negatif sesuai petunjuk.

questions.q: 1. I'm very tired. I [BLANK] (not go) to the party tonight.
questions.hint: I + am not going to + verb
questions.explanation: Bentuk negatif untuk 'I' adalah 'am not going to go'.

questions.q: 2. We [BLANK] (visit) our grandparents next Sunday.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'we' berpasangan dengan 'are going to visit'.

questions.q: 3. Look at those dark clouds! It [BLANK] (rain).
questions.explanation: Prediksi dengan bukti kuat menggunakan 'is going to rain'.

questions.q: 4. Mark [BLANK] (not buy) that car because it's too expensive.
questions.hint: Mark + is not going to + buy
questions.explanation: Bentuk negatif untuk orang ketiga tunggal adalah 'is not going to buy' atau 'isn't going to buy'.

questions.q: 5. They [BLANK] (start) their new project tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'They' memakai 'are going to start'.

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Menuliskan Jadwal Buku Harian (Diary) dengan be going to
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kalimat yang tepat sesuai jadwal rencana pada buku harian (diary).

questions.q: 1. Sesuai catatan agenda Minggu pukul 9 pagi: 'Sunday: Football match at 9 a.m.'
options: I'm going to go to the football match at 9 on Sunday morning.
I go to football match every Sunday morning.
I will to play football at 9 Sunday.
questions.answer: I'm going to go to the football match at 9 on Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: Rencana yang telah tercatat dalam agenda dinyatakan dengan 'be going to'.

questions.q: 2. Bagaimana menyatakan rencana belajar kelompok hari Senin (Monday)?
options: I'm going to study with my classmates on Monday afternoon.
I study on Monday afternoon yesterday.
questions.answer: I'm going to study with my classmates on Monday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Gunakan struktur 'I am going to + V1' untuk rencana pribadi yang telah diagendakan.

grammar.summary: Kata ganti refleksif digunakan ketika subjek dan objek kalimat adalah orang/hal yang sama, atau untuk memberi penekanan bahwa perbuatan dilakukan sendiri (by myself = alone).
rules: Gunakan kata ganti refleksif saat subjek melakukan aksi terhadap dirinya sendiri: 'Tony cut himself with the scissors.'
Kata kerja yang sering berpasangan: hurt, enjoy, introduce, teach, look at.
'by + reflexive pronoun' bermakna sendiri tanpa bantuan: 'She cooked the dinner by herself.'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Memilih Kata Ganti Refleksif yang Tepat (Reflexive Pronouns)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kata ganti refleksif yang sesuai dengan subjek kalimat.

questions.q: 1. I made this chocolate cake all by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Kata ganti refleksif untuk 'I' adalah 'myself'.

questions.q: 2. Be careful with that sharp knife! You might cut [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Kata ganti refleksif untuk orang kedua tunggal 'you' adalah 'yourself'.

questions.q: 3. David looked at [BLANK] in the bathroom mirror.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'David' (he) berpasangan dengan 'himself'.

questions.q: 4. Maria introduced [BLANK] to the new students.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'Maria' (she) berpasangan dengan 'herself'.

questions.q: 5. The little cat washed [BLANK] after drinking the milk.
questions.explanation: Kata ganti refleksif untuk hewan tunggal 'the cat' adalah 'itself'.

questions.q: 6. We really enjoyed [BLANK] at the beach yesterday.
questions.explanation: Ungkapan 'enjoy oneself' untuk 'we' adalah 'enjoyed ourselves'.

questions.q: 7. Did you children paint these lovely pictures [BLANK]?
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak orang kedua 'you children' adalah 'yourselves'.

questions.q: 8. The boys built the treehouse all by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Kata ganti refleksif untuk 'they' adalah 'themselves'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Melengkapi dengan Kata Ganti Refleksif (Fill in the Blanks)
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata ganti refleksif yang tepat pada kolom isian.

questions.q: 1. She taught [BLANK] how to play the acoustic guitar.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'She' membutuhkan reflexive pronoun 'herself'.

questions.q: 2. I don't need any help, I can do it [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' berpasangan dengan 'myself'.

questions.q: 3. The computer turned [BLANK] off automatically after 10 minutes.
questions.explanation: Benda tunggal 'the computer' memakai 'itself'.

questions.q: 4. Tom and Jerry can't blame anyone else; they must blame [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak orang ketiga memakai 'themselves'.

questions.q: 5. We prepared [BLANK] thoroughly for the final semester exam.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'We' berpasangan dengan 'ourselves'.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Pemahaman Kalimat Rekaman Audio TR 7
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 7 dan pilih kata ganti refleksif yang tepat sesuai narasi percakapan.

questions.q: 1. Tony cut [BLANK] with the scissors.
questions.explanation: Tony melukai dirinya sendiri: 'Tony cut himself with the scissors.'

questions.q: 2. Don't worry about them. They can take care of [BLANK].
questions.explanation: They can take care of themselves.

questions.q: 3. The girl was lucky when she fell off her bike that she didn't badly hurt [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Gadis itu tidak melukai dirinya parah: 'didn't badly hurt herself.'

questions.q: 4. Be careful! The oven is on. Don't burn [BLANK]!
questions.explanation: Peringatan langsung: 'Don't burn yourself.'

questions.q: 5. William and Jeff climbed to the top of the mountain by [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Mendaki sendiri tanpa bantuan orang lain: 'by themselves.'

questions.q: 6. They locked [BLANK] out by mistake.
questions.explanation: Kunci tertinggal di mobil sehingga terkunci dari luar: 'locked themselves out'.

questions.q: 7. It's not our fault. We shouldn't blame [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Kita tidak boleh menyalahkan diri sendiri: 'blame ourselves'.

questions.q: 8. I'm such a fool! I could kick [BLANK]!
questions.explanation: Ungkapan kesal pada diri sendiri: 'kick myself'.

questions.q: 9. The exhibition was great. We really enjoyed [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Kami sangat bersenang-senang menikmati pameran: 'enjoyed ourselves'.

questions.q: 10. I don't want you to pay for me. I'll pay for [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Membayar untuk diri sendiri: 'pay for myself'.

grammar.summary: Kata kerja 'get' adalah salah satu kata kerja paling fleksibel dalam bahasa Inggris dengan berbagai makna: berubah keadaan (become), menerima/memperoleh (receive/obtain), dan tiba/sampai (arrive).

tables.title: Tiga Makna Utama 'to get'
rows: get tired, get dark, get old, get angry, get cold
get an email, get a present, get a job, get tickets
get home, get to school, get to the station

rules: Bentuk lampau dari 'get' adalah 'got', bentuk ketiga (past participle) adalah 'got' (UK) atau 'gotten' (US).
Frasa 'get home' TIDAK memakai 'to' (BUKAN get to home).
Phrasal verb umum: get up (bangun tidur), get on/off (naik/turun kendaraan umum), get out of (keluar).

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Berbagai Makna Kata Kerja to get
exercises.instruction: Tentukan arti kata 'get' pada kalimat berikut: menjadi (become), menerima/membeli (receive/buy), atau tiba (arrive).

questions.q: 1. It's getting dark outside. Let's turn on the lamp.
questions.explanation: 'get + kata sifat' bermakna mengalami perubahan kondisi / menjadi (become).

questions.q: 2. Did you get my text message earlier?
questions.explanation: 'get + pesan/surat' bermakna menerima (receive).

questions.q: 3. What time do you usually get home from school?
questions.explanation: 'get + keterangan tempat' bermakna tiba atau sampai (arrive).

questions.q: 4. I got a lovely pair of shoes for my birthday.
questions.explanation: 'got a pair of shoes' bermakna menerima hadiah atau memperoleh barang.

questions.q: 5. Drink some warm tea if you get cold.
questions.explanation: 'get cold' bermakna menjadi kedinginan.

questions.q: 3. A: I'm getting bored of doing my homework. B: [BLANK]

Why don't you ask for help?

questions.q: 5. A: It's getting late. B: [BLANK]

questions.q: 6. A: We got an email. B: [BLANK]

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Kata Kerja Majemuk Phrasal Verbs dengan get (Audio TR 9)
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat dengan preposisi phrasal verb yang tepat (up, on, in, off, out of) sesuai rekaman TR 9.

questions.q: 1. I was late for work because I didn't get [BLANK] in time.

questions.q: 2. I have to go to the station and get [BLANK] my train at 8 o'clock.

units.title: could (Kemampuan Masa Lalu & Kesopanan)
units.english_title: could: Past Ability, Polite Requests, Possibility

grammar.summary: 'Could' digunakan untuk menyatakan kemampuan umum di masa lampau, meminta bantuan dengan santun, atau menyatakan kemungkinan.

tables.title: Fungsi could
rows: I could swim when I was six.
Could you help me with this box?
Could I use your phone, please?
It could be very hot tomorrow.

rules: Bentuk negatif dari could adalah couldn't (could not).
Selalu diikuti kata kerja bentuk pertama tanpa 'to'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kemampuan Masa Lalu (could / couldn't)
exercises.instruction: Ketik could atau couldn't untuk menyatakan kemampuan di masa lampau.

questions.q: 1. When I was six years old, I [BLANK] swim, but now I can.
questions.explanation: Menyatakan ketidakmampuan di masa lalu: 'couldn't'.

questions.q: 2. Mozart was very talented; he [BLANK] play the piano when he was only four.
questions.explanation: Menyatakan kemampuan di masa lampau: 'could'.

questions.q: 3. The exam was so hard that I [BLANK] finish all the questions in time.
questions.hint: Ujian sangat sulit sehingga tidak selesai.
questions.explanation: Ketidakmampuan menyelesaikan: 'couldn't finish'.

questions.q: 4. We looked everywhere for the keys, but we [BLANK] find them.
questions.hint: Mencari ke mana-mana tapi tidak berhasil.
questions.explanation: Tidak berhasil menemukan: 'couldn't find them'.

questions.q: 5. In the 19th century, people [BLANK] travel by steam train.
questions.explanation: Kemampuan umum di masa lalu: 'could travel'.

exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan telepon dan permintaan tolong pada rekaman TR 10, lalu jawab pertanyaan pemahaman berikut.

questions.q: 1. Percakapan 1: Mengapa Diane tidak masuk sekolah hari ini?
options: Dia sakit flu (She has the flu).
Dia sedang berlibur di luar kota.

questions.explanation: Diane bertanya: 'Could you tell me if we have any homework for next week?'

questions.q: 3. Percakapan 2: Mengapa Anne meminta tolong kepada Jack untuk mengantarnya ke tempat kursus?
options: Mobilnya sedang diperbaiki di bengkel (her car is being fixed in the garage).
Dia tidak bisa mengemudi sama sekali.
questions.answer: Mobilnya sedang diperbaiki di bengkel (her car is being fixed in the garage).
questions.hint: car is being fixed in the garage
questions.explanation: Anne mengatakan: 'my car is being fixed in the garage.'

questions.q: 4. Percakapan 2: Bagaimana Anne meminta tolong kepada Jack secara sopan?
options: Could you do me a favour, please? Could you drive me to class?
You must drive me to class now.
Do you drive me to class tonight?

questions.hint: Could you do me a favour...
questions.explanation: Permintaan sopan: 'Could you do me a favour, please? Could you drive me to class?'
