grammar.summary: Kata penentu jumlah (quantifiers) yang digunakan bersama kata benda dapat dihitung (countable) maupun tidak dapat dihitung (uncountable).

tables.title: Aturan some, any, no, every
rows: I have some apples. Would you like some tea?
I don't have any money. Do you have any pens?
Bermakna negatif tapi dengan kata kerja positif (+)
There are no chairs in the room.

rules: Jangan gunakan 'no' bersama kalimat yang sudah ada 'not' (Double negative salah: BUKAN 'I don't have no time').
'Every' selalu diikuti kata benda tunggal: 'every student', bukan 'every students'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Penggunaan some, any, no, dan every
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata yang tepat (some, any, no, every) untuk melengkapi kalimat berikut.

questions.q: 1. We've got [BLANK] lemons but we haven't got any bread.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'some' dalam kalimat positif untuk benda yang ada.

questions.q: 2. I don't have [BLANK] clean socks to wear!
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'any' setelah kata kerja negatif (don't have).

questions.q: 3. There were [BLANK] people from my school at the party. Five or six girls.
questions.explanation: 'some people' bermakna beberapa orang.

questions.q: 4. Can I have [BLANK] biscuits, please?
questions.explanation: Dalam permintaan atau tawaran sopan (Can I have / Would you like), gunakan 'some'.

questions.q: 5. I take a shower [BLANK] morning.
questions.explanation: 'every morning' bermakna setiap pagi.

questions.q: 6. [BLANK] time he calls, he complains.
questions.explanation: 'Every time' bermakna setiap saat / setiap kali.

questions.q: 7. Would you like [BLANK] milk in your coffee?
questions.explanation: Dalam tawaran 'Would you like...', gunakan 'some'.

questions.q: 8. When he moved to New York, he had [BLANK] place to stay. He slept at the station!
questions.hint: Sama sekali tidak punya tempat (negatif tanpa not)
questions.explanation: 'had no place to stay' bermakna sama sekali tidak punya tempat tinggal.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Membedakan some vs any
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk kata penentu yang benar sesuai jenis kalimat (positif, negatif, tanya).

questions.q: 1. Are there [BLANK] good restaurants near here?
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'any' dalam kalimat tanya umum.

questions.q: 2. There are [BLANK] beautiful flowers in her garden.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'some' dalam kalimat positif untuk benda jamak terhitung.

questions.q: 3. She didn't buy [BLANK] souvenirs during the trip.
questions.explanation: Kalimat negatif menggunakan 'any'.

questions.q: 4. We have [BLANK] reason to doubt his honesty.
questions.hint: Makna: tidak ada alasan sama sekali
questions.explanation: 'have no reason' menyatakan ketiadaan alasan secara tegas.

units.title: Bentuk Majemuk dari some, any, no, every
units.english_title: Compound Words of some, any, no, every

grammar.summary: Penggabungan kata some, any, no, every dengan -one/-body (orang), -thing (benda), dan -where (tempat).
rules: Kata majemuk ini SELALU diperlakukan sebagai subjek tunggal (singular verb): 'Everybody is ready' (BUKAN 'are').
Gunakan no- untuk kalimat positif bermakna negatif: 'Nobody called me today.'
Gunakan any- untuk kalimat tanya atau kalimat negatif: 'Did anyone see my keys?'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kata Majemuk Indefinite Pronouns (someone, anything, nowhere, everybody)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kata ganti tak tentu yang paling tepat sesuai konteks kalimat.

questions.q: 1. Listen! [BLANK] is knocking at the front door.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'someone' atau 'somebody' dalam kalimat positif.

questions.q: 2. I'm so hungry, but there is [BLANK] to eat in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 'there is nothing to eat' bermakna tidak ada makanan sama sekali.

questions.q: 3. Did you meet [BLANK] interesting at the seminar?
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'anyone' atau 'anybody' dalam kalimat tanya.

questions.q: 4. We want to go [BLANK] warm and quiet for our summer vacation.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'somewhere' untuk menyatakan tempat tertentu dalam kalimat positif.

questions.q: 5. Don't worry! [BLANK] in our class passed the final exam.
questions.explanation: 'Everyone' (semua orang) menggunakan kata kerja tunggal 'passed'.

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Cerita Anak Kucing di Hari Sabtu Hujan (Audio TR 13)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan cerita narasi pada rekaman TR 13, lalu ketik kata majemuk yang hilang pada bagian yang kosong.

questions.q: 1. It was a rainy, grey Saturday afternoon when [BLANK] knocked at my door.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 13: 'when someone knocked at my door.'

questions.q: 2. 'Who's there?' I asked. But [BLANK] answered.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 13: 'But no one answered.'

questions.q: 3. So I slowly opened the door to see if [BLANK] was waiting.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 13: 'to see if somebody was waiting.'

questions.q: 4. But there wasn't [BLANK] in sight.
questions.hint: Tidak ada siapapun yang terlihat (setelah wasn't)
questions.explanation: Audio TR 13: 'there wasn't anybody in sight.'

questions.q: 5. Suddenly, I heard [BLANK] make a noise. I saw a small fluffy kitten.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 13: 'I heard something make a noise.'

questions.q: 6. 'It must be somewhere,' I thought, but I couldn't find it [BLANK]. It ran away.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 13: 'couldn't find it anywhere.'

grammar.summary: 'have to' menyatakan kewajiban/keharusan dari pihak luar (aturan, hukum, jadwal). 'don't have to' menyatakan tidak adanya keharusan (tidak wajib/bebas).
rules: 'don't have to' BUKAN berarti larangan (prohibition), melainkan 'kamu tidak perlu/bebas memilih'.
Untuk larangan mutlak, gunakan 'mustn't' atau 'cannot'.
Bentuk lampau dari have to / has to adalah 'had to': 'I had to go to the doctor yesterday.'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kewajiban Menggunakan have to / has to
exercises.instruction: Ketik have to atau has to sesuai subjek kalimat.

questions.q: 1. Doctors [BLANK] work long hours, including night shifts.
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'Doctors' menggunakan 'have to'.

questions.q: 2. My brother [BLANK] wear a formal uniform at his school.
questions.hint: My brother adalah orang ketiga tunggal (he)
questions.explanation: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal 'My brother' menggunakan 'has to'.

questions.q: 3. We [BLANK] submit our biology assignments before Friday.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'We' berpasangan dengan 'have to'.

questions.q: 4. She [BLANK] wake up early every weekday to catch the morning train.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'She' menggunakan 'has to'.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Kalimat Kewajiban Nyata (Audio TR 14)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 14 dan lengkapi bagian alasan kewajiban berikut.

questions.q: 1. I don't want to miss my plane so I [BLANK] catch the 7:10 train.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 14: 'so I have to catch the 7:10 train.'

questions.q: 2. I didn't do well on my last English test so I [BLANK] study more this time.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 14: 'so I have to study more this time.'

questions.q: 3. My mother is away this week so I [BLANK] do the housework.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 14: 'so I have to do the housework.'

questions.q: 4. I've got a cold so I [BLANK] stay in bed for a few days.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 14: 'so I have to stay in bed for a few days.'

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Percakapan Pekerjaan Sam & Tony (Audio TR 15)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan Sam dan Tony mengenai pekerjaan barunya pada audio TR 15, lalu pilih jawaban yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Apa pekerjaan baru Tony sekarang?
options: Product manager for a food company
A cashier in a local supermarket
A travel agent for international clients
questions.answer: Product manager for a food company
questions.hint: I'm a product manager for a company that sells food.
questions.explanation: Tony menjelaskan jabatannya sebagai product manager di perusahaan makanan.

questions.q: 2. Pukul berapa Tony harus mulai bekerja di pagi hari?
options: Pukul 05.00 pagi (at five in the morning)
questions.answer: Pukul 05.00 pagi (at five in the morning)
questions.hint: start work at five in the morning
questions.explanation: Tony harus mulai bekerja pukul 5 pagi: 'start work at five in the morning!'

questions.q: 3. Apakah Tony harus ikut bepergian ke luar negeri bersama bosnya?
options: Tidak, dia tidak harus ikut tetapi menggantikan di kantor (No, he doesn't have to).
Ya, dia harus pergi ke Irlandia dan Skotlandia.
questions.answer: Tidak, dia tidak harus ikut tetapi menggantikan di kantor (No, he doesn't have to).
questions.hint: No, I don't have to but I have to fill in for him in the office.
questions.explanation: Tony tidak wajib ikut: 'No, I don't have to but I have to fill in for him in the office.'

units.title: should, shall, ought to atau shouldn't

grammar.summary: 'should' dan 'ought to' digunakan untuk memberikan saran atau anjuran. 'shouldn't' digunakan untuk menyarankan agar tidak melakukan sesuatu. 'shall' digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan atau mengajak.

tables.title: Ringkasan Modal Saran
rows: You shouldn't eat too much candy.
Shall I carry that bag for you?

rules: 'should' dan 'shouldn't' langsung diikuti V1 tanpa to.
'ought to' selalu menggunakan 'to' sebelum kata kerja: 'You ought to apologize.'
'shall' dalam bahasa Inggris modern paling umum dipakai dalam kalimat tanya dengan subjek 'I' atau 'we'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Memberi Nasihat dengan should (Audio TR 16)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan keluhan masalah sehari-hari pada audio TR 16, lalu pilih saran yang tepat menggunakan should.

questions.q: 1. A: I've got the flu. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Audio TR 16 nomor 1: 'You should stay in bed.'

questions.q: 2. A: My feet hurt. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Audio TR 16 nomor 2: 'You should buy new shoes.'

questions.q: 3. A: This jacket is too tight. → B: [BLANK]
options: You should buy a new one.
You should go to bed earlier.
questions.answer: You should buy a new one.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 16 nomor 3: 'You should buy a new one.'

questions.q: 4. A: I'm always tired in the morning. → B: [BLANK]
options: You should go to bed earlier.
questions.answer: You should go to bed earlier.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 16 nomor 4: 'You should go to bed earlier.'

questions.q: 5. A: I don't feel like walking. → B: [BLANK]
options: You should buy her some flowers.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 16 nomor 6: 'You should take a taxi.'

questions.q: 6. A: Tomorrow is my mother's birthday. → B: [BLANK]
options: You should buy her some flowers.
questions.answer: You should buy her some flowers.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 16 nomor 10: 'You should buy her some flowers.'

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Konsultasi Dokter (Audio TR 17)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan saran dokter pada ketiga dialog rekaman TR 17 dan jawab pertanyaan pemahaman berikut.

questions.q: 1. Dialog 1: Apa saran dokter kepada Miss Smith yang sakit kepala parah karena stres kerja?
options: You should take some time off work.
You should change your diet immediately.
You should exercise twice a week.
questions.answer: You should take some time off work.
questions.explanation: Dokter menyarankan: 'I think you should take some time off work.'

questions.q: 2. Dialog 2: Apa nasihat dokter mengenai pola makan Mr. Kane yang menyukai burger dan pizza?
options: You shouldn't eat that kind of food. You should eat lots of fruit and vegetables.
You should eat more pizza for energy.
You should only drink warm water.
questions.answer: You shouldn't eat that kind of food. You should eat lots of fruit and vegetables.
questions.explanation: Dokter menegur: 'You shouldn't eat that kind of food. You should eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'

questions.q: 3. Dialog 3: Mengapa Janet tidak bisa tidur nyenyak di malam hari?
options: Dia baru pindah rumah dan lelah merapikan semuanya sendirian sampai larut malam.
Dia minum kopi terlalu banyak sebelum tidur.
questions.answer: Dia baru pindah rumah dan lelah merapikan semuanya sendirian sampai larut malam.
questions.hint: moved house about a month ago
questions.explanation: Janet sibuk menata rumah barunya sendirian hingga larut malam.

questions.q: 4. Dialog 3: Apa saran Dr. Jefferson kepada Janet?
options: You should get somebody to help you, and you shouldn't work until late.
You should move to another house.
questions.answer: You should get somebody to help you, and you shouldn't work until late.
questions.explanation: Dokter menyarankan mencari bantuan dan tidak bekerja hingga larut.

grammar.summary: Present Perfect (have/has + Past Participle V3) menghubungkan masa lalu dengan masa sekarang. Digunakan untuk pengalaman hidup (ever/never), peristiwa baru saja terjadi (just/already/yet), serta perubahan/hasil yang dirasakan sekarang.

tables.title: Perbedaan been to vs gone to
rows: Pernah ke sana dan sudah kembali pulang
Pergi ke sana dan belum pulang
Sekarang masih berada di tempat tujuan.

rules: Gunakan 'ever' dalam kalimat tanya: 'Have you ever been to Bali?'
Gunakan 'never' untuk kalimat positif bermakna belum pernah: 'I have never eaten sushi.'
'yet' digunakan di akhir kalimat negatif dan kalimat tanya: 'I haven't finished yet.'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Bentuk Past Participle (V3) untuk Present Perfect
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk kata kerja ketiga (Past Participle / V3) dari kata kerja dasar berikut.

questions.q: 1. be → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'be' adalah 'been'.

questions.q: 2. see → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'see' adalah 'seen'.

questions.q: 3. eat → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'eat' adalah 'eaten'.

questions.q: 4. write → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'write' adalah 'written' (dengan double t).

questions.q: 5. do → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'do' adalah 'done'.

questions.q: 6. go → [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'go' adalah 'gone' atau 'been'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Pengalaman Wisata Emily & Jessica (Audio TR 18)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan pengalaman perjalanan pada audio TR 18, lalu tentukan pernyataan yang benar.

questions.q: 1. Kota manakah di Amerika Serikat yang pernah dikunjungi oleh Jessica?
questions.hint: I've been to New York and Washington.
questions.explanation: Jessica menyatakan: 'I've been to New York and Washington.'

questions.q: 2. Apakah Jessica pernah pergi ke San Francisco atau Los Angeles?
options: Belum pernah sama sekali (never been there).
Pernah satu kali dua tahun lalu.
questions.answer: Belum pernah sama sekali (never been there).
questions.hint: never been to San Francisco or Los Angeles
questions.explanation: Jessica mengatakan: 'I've never been to San Francisco or Los Angeles.'

questions.q: 3. Siapakah yang pernah mengunjungi Irlandia (Ireland)?
options: Emily pernah ke sana beberapa tahun yang lalu.
questions.answer: Emily pernah ke sana beberapa tahun yang lalu.
questions.hint: Yes, I have. I went a couple of years ago.
questions.explanation: Emily menjawab: 'Yes, I have. I went a couple of years ago.'

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Kalimat Tanya Present Perfect (Audio TR 19)
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat tanya Present Perfect berikut sesuai rekaman TR 19.

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] you heard the news?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan untuk subjek 'you': 'Have you heard the news?'

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] your father left for work yet?
questions.hint: Your father adalah orang ketiga tunggal (he)
questions.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'your father' memakai kata bantu 'Has'.

questions.q: 3. Have you had dinner [BLANK]?
questions.explanation: Kata 'yet' digunakan di akhir kalimat tanya atau negatif untuk menanyakan keterlaksanaan.

questions.q: 4. How long have you [BLANK] (know) him?
questions.explanation: Past participle dari 'know' adalah 'known'.

questions.q: 5. Have you [BLANK] seen this programme before?
questions.explanation: 'ever' bermakna pernah dalam kalimat tanya Present Perfect.

grammar.summary: Digunakan untuk menyatakan kegiatan yang telah dimulai di masa lalu dan masih terus berlangsung hingga saat ini, atau baru saja berhenti dengan bukti yang jelas saat ini.

tables.title: Rumus Present Perfect Continuous
rows: It has been raining for two hours.
I haven't been sleeping well lately.
How long + have/has + Subject + been + V-ing?
How long have you been studying English?

tables.title: Perbedaan for vs since
rows: for two hours, for three days, for ten years
since 8 a.m., since Monday, since 2015, since yesterday

rules: Pertanyaan mengenai durasi kegiatan menggunakan 'How long have you been...?'
Kata kerja statis (state verbs seperti know, like, believe) umumnya menggunakan Present Perfect Simple, bukan Continuous.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Bentuk Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing)
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk Present Perfect Continuous yang benar (have been / has been + kata kerja berakhiran -ing).

questions.q: 1. It [BLANK] (rain) heavily for three hours.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'It' menggunakan 'has been raining' untuk aktivitas yang berlangsung terus-menerus.

questions.q: 2. They [BLANK] (wait) for the delayed bus since 8 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'They' menggunakan 'have been waiting'.

questions.q: 3. She [BLANK] (study) English at this academy for two years.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'She' menggunakan 'has been studying'.

questions.q: 4. I [BLANK] (learn) how to code software recently.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' menggunakan 'have been learning'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Penggunaan for vs since
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah 'for' (periode durasi waktu) atau 'since' (titik awal waktu) yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. We have been living in this city [BLANK] 2018.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'since' sebelum tahun atau titik awal waktu.

questions.q: 2. He has been playing football [BLANK] two hours.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'for' sebelum durasi atau rentang waktu.

questions.q: 3. I haven't seen Sarah [BLANK] last Monday.
questions.explanation: Titik waktu tertentu memakai 'since'.

questions.q: 4. They have been working on the project [BLANK] six months.
questions.explanation: Rentang durasi memakai 'for'.

units.title: Klausa penghubung (Relative Clauses)
units.english_title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that, where, whose

grammar.summary: Klausa penghubung memberikan informasi tambahan tentang orang, benda, kepemilikan, atau tempat tanpa harus membuat kalimat baru.

tables.title: Kata Ganti Relatif (Relative Pronouns)
rows: The girl who won the race is my sister.
The book which is on the table is mine.
The laptop that I bought is fast.
This is the restaurant where we had dinner.
I met a boy whose father is an astronaut.

rules: 'who' menggantikan he/she/they.
'whose' menggantikan his/her/their untuk kepemilikan.
'where' menggantikan there / at that place.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kata Ganti Penghubung (who, which, where, whose)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah relative pronoun yang tepat untuk melengkapi klausa penjelas.

questions.q: 1. That is the architect [BLANK] designed our school library.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'who' untuk merujuk pada orang.

questions.q: 2. Here is the laptop [BLANK] I bought last week.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'which' atau 'that' untuk benda.

questions.q: 3. This is the town [BLANK] William Shakespeare was born.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'where' untuk merujuk pada tempat terjadinya sesuatu.

questions.q: 4. I met a boy [BLANK] brother is a famous singer.
questions.hint: Kepemilikan saudara laki-laki dari anak itu
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'whose' untuk menyatakan hubungan kepemilikan.

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Pemahaman Klausa Relatif (Audio TR 20)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman audio TR 20 dan lengkapi klausa relatif yang diucapkan.

questions.q: 1. The eggs [BLANK] I bought yesterday are bad.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 1: 'The eggs which I bought yesterday are bad.'

questions.q: 2. The boy [BLANK] broke the window will be punished.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 2: 'The boy who broke the window will be punished.'

questions.q: 3. The hairdresser [BLANK] cut your hair did a good job.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 3: 'The hairdresser who cut your hair did a good job.'

questions.q: 4. This is the shop [BLANK] I go to buy my clothes.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 20 nomor 5: 'This is the shop where I go to buy my clothes.'

units.title: Kata kerja + infinitif; kata kerja + ing

grammar.summary: Ketika dua kata kerja berdampingan, kata kerja kedua bisa berbentuk to-infinitive (to do) atau gerund (-ing) tergantung kata kerja utamanya.

tables.title: Daftar Kata Kerja dan Polanya
rows: want, hope, decide, plan, promise, learn, offer
enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, practice, imagine
good at, interested in, keen on, tired of

rules: Setelah kata depan (preposisi: at, in, of, about, etc.), kata kerja SELALU berakhiran -ing.
Beberapa kata kerja seperti like, love, hate dapat diikuti keduanya dengan makna serupa.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kata Kerja Diikuti to + Infinitif atau -ing (Gerund)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk kata kerja turunan yang tepat setelah kata kerja utama.

questions.q: 1. We decided [BLANK] our holidays in Greece this summer.
questions.explanation: Kata kerja 'decide' selalu diikuti oleh 'to + infinitive'.

questions.q: 2. My father enjoys [BLANK] historical fiction novels.
questions.explanation: Kata kerja 'enjoy' selalu diikuti oleh bentuk gerund (-ing).

questions.q: 3. Don't forget [BLANK] the door before you go to bed.
questions.explanation: 'forget to + infinitive' bermakna ingat untuk melakukan suatu tindakan.

questions.q: 4. She avoids [BLANK] sugary drinks when she is on a diet.
questions.explanation: 'avoid' diikuti oleh kata kerja bentuk -ing (gerund).

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Percakapan Rencana Andy & Angela (Audio TR 22)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan Andy dan Angela pada audio TR 22, lalu pilih jawaban yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Mengapa Angela tidak bisa makan malam bersama Andy malam ini?
options: Karena Angela ada kelas bahasa Rusia (has a Russian class).
questions.answer: Karena Angela ada kelas bahasa Rusia (has a Russian class).
questions.explanation: Angela menolak ajakan makan malam hari ini karena ada kelas bahasa Rusia.

questions.q: 2. Apa yang ingin dilakukan Andy pada hari Sabtu malam?
options: Pergi ke bioskop menonton film (go to the cinema).
questions.answer: Pergi ke bioskop menonton film (go to the cinema).
questions.hint: I want to go to the cinema. I love watching films.
questions.explanation: Andy mengajak ke bioskop jam 8 malam.

questions.q: 3. Mengapa Andy tidak bisa menjemput Angela dengan mobilnya di rumah?
options: Andy sudah berjanji meminjamkan mobilnya kepada saudara laki-lakinya.
questions.answer: Andy sudah berjanji meminjamkan mobilnya kepada saudara laki-lakinya.
questions.hint: I promised to lend my car to my brother Saturday.
questions.explanation: Andy mengatakan: 'I promised to lend my car to my brother Saturday.'

grammar.summary: 'will' digunakan untuk keputusan spontan saat berbicara, prediksi masa depan menurut opini, janji, tawaran, dan penolakan (won't).

tables.title: Pola Kalimat will
rows: I'll have a glass of water, please.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
Will robots replace teachers in the future?

rules: will = keputusan saat itu juga (spontan). be going to = rencana yang sudah dibuat sebelumnya.
Sering dipadukan dengan 'I think...', 'I hope...', 'Maybe...'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Prediksi Masa Depan dengan will / won't
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk will atau won't yang tepat untuk melengkapi ramalan masa depan.

questions.q: 1. I think scientists [BLANK] discover a cure for cancer in the future.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'will' setelah opini atau keyakinan masa depan ('I think...').

questions.q: 2. Don't worry about the math test. I'm sure you [BLANK] fail.
questions.explanation: 'won't' (will not) digunakan untuk menyatakan keyakinan bahwa sesuatu tidak akan terjadi.

questions.q: 3. In fifty years, people [BLANK] probably drive flying electric cars.
questions.explanation: Prediksi dengan kata 'probably' memakai 'will'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Keputusan Spontan & Janji dengan will ('ll)
exercises.instruction: Ketik 'll atau will beserta kata kerja dasar untuk merespon situasi secara spontan.

questions.q: 1. A: The phone is ringing. B: Don't get up. I [BLANK] (answer) it.
questions.hint: Keputusan spontan saat berbicara: I'll answer
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'will / 'll' untuk keputusan yang dibuat secara spontan pada saat berbicara.

questions.q: 2. A: This suitcase is so heavy! B: Wait, I [BLANK] (help) you carry it.
questions.explanation: Menawarkan bantuan secara spontan: 'I'll help you'.

questions.q: 3. I promise I [BLANK] (not tell) anyone your secret.
questions.explanation: Membuat janji negatif memakai 'won't tell'.

grammar.summary: First Conditional digunakan untuk situasi nyata yang mungkin terjadi di masa depan jika suatu syarat terpenuhi.

tables.title: Rumus First Conditional
rows: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
We will stay at home if it rains tomorrow.

rules: JANGAN gunakan 'will' di dalam klausa 'If': BUKAN 'If it will rain', melainkan 'If it rains'.
Bila If-clause di depan, gunakan tanda koma (,). Bila di belakang, tidak perlu koma.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, will + V1)
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat pengandaian nyata kemungkinan masa depan (First Conditional).

questions.q: 1. If it rains tomorrow, we [BLANK] (cancel) the outdoor barbecue.
questions.explanation: Pola First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + Verb 1.

questions.q: 2. If you [BLANK] (study) hard, you will pass your final exams easily.
questions.explanation: Setelah 'if' gunakan bentuk Present Simple ('study').

questions.q: 3. She will miss the early train if she [BLANK] (not hurry).
questions.hint: Present Simple negatif untuk subjek she: doesn't hurry
questions.explanation: Subjek 'she' menggunakan 'doesn't hurry' dalam klausa if.

questions.q: 4. If we don't protect the rainforests, many wild animals [BLANK] (lose) their habitats.
questions.explanation: Konsekuensi masa depan memakai 'will lose'.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Kalimat Kondisional Pertama (Audio TR 23)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan rekaman klausa pada audio TR 23, lalu pasangkan dengan kelanjutan kalimat yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Audio: 'If he has to work late...' → Kelanjutan yang tepat:
options: we'll have a picnic in the park.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 23: 'If he has to work late, he'll call her tomorrow.'

questions.q: 2. Audio: 'If it's a nice day tomorrow...' → Kelanjutan yang tepat:
questions.explanation: Audio TR 23: 'If it's a nice day tomorrow, we'll have a picnic.'

questions.q: 3. Audio: 'If you don't eat properly...' → Kelanjutan yang tepat:
questions.hint: Tidak makan dengan benar menyebabkan jatuh sakit
questions.explanation: Kondisi tidak makan sehat mengakibatkan jatuh sakit.

grammar.summary: Second Conditional digunakan untuk mengandaikan situasi yang berlawanan dengan kenyataan saat ini (khayalan/imajiner), atau situasi yang sangat kecil kemungkinannya terjadi.

tables.title: Rumus Second Conditional
rows: If I had a million dollars, I would buy an island.
I would travel the world if I were rich.

rules: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal, 'were' digunakan untuk semua subjek (termasuk I, he, she, it): 'If I were you, I would study harder.' (ungkapan memberi saran).
Kenyataannya sekarang adalah sebaliknya: 'If I had time' berarti 'I don't have time now'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Second Conditional (If + Past Simple, would + V1)
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat pengandaian imajiner / tidak nyata saat ini (Second Conditional).

questions.q: 1. If I won a million dollars, I [BLANK] (travel) around the entire world.
questions.explanation: Pola Second Conditional: If + Past Simple, would + Verb 1.

questions.q: 2. If she [BLANK] (have) more free time, she would learn how to paint.
questions.explanation: Klausa if menggunakan kata kerja bentuk lampau (had).

questions.q: 3. If I [BLANK] (be) you, I would consult a professional doctor immediately.
questions.explanation: Dalam Second Conditional formal, bentuk to be untuk semua subjek adalah 'were' (If I were you...).

questions.q: 4. What [BLANK] you do if you saw a ghost in an old castle?
questions.explanation: Kalimat tanya Second Conditional: What would you do if...?

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Percakapan Rencana Menang Lotre Monica & Terry (Audio TR 24)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan pengandaian Monica dan Terry pada audio TR 24, lalu pilih jawaban yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Apa hal pertama yang ingin dibeli Terry jika dia memenangkan lotre?
options: A new car (Mobil baru karena mobil lamanya sering mogok)
questions.answer: A new car (Mobil baru karena mobil lamanya sering mogok)
questions.hint: First of all I'd buy a new car. Mine is old and it's always breaking down.
questions.explanation: Terry ingin membeli mobil baru terlebih dahulu karena mobil tuanya sering rusak.

questions.q: 2. Di manakah lokasi rumah yang ingin dibeli Terry?
options: A house in the country close to where his parents live
A penthouse in New York City
A villa on a tropical beach
questions.answer: A house in the country close to where his parents live
questions.hint: a house in the country close to where my parents live
questions.explanation: Terry ingin rumah di desa dekat tempat tinggal orang tuanya.

questions.q: 3. Selain membeli barang untuk diri sendiri, apa perbuatan baik yang akan dilakukan Terry dan Monica?
options: Menyumbangkan banyak uang ke organisasi sosial (donate money to organisations that help the needy).
questions.answer: Menyumbangkan banyak uang ke organisasi sosial (donate money to organisations that help the needy).
questions.hint: donate a lot of money to organisations that help the needy
questions.explanation: Keduanya sepakat untuk mendonasikan uang bagi orang-orang yang membutuhkan.

grammar.summary: Kalimat tidak langsung digunakan untuk menceritakan kembali ucapan orang lain. Terjadi perubahan tenses (mundur satu tingkat ke masa lampau), kata ganti orang, dan penanda waktu.

tables.title: Perbedaan say vs tell
rows: He told ME (that) he was tired.

rules: Perubahan penanda waktu: now -> then, today -> that day, tomorrow -> the next day, yesterday -> the day before.
Perubahan kata tunjuk: this -> that, these -> those, here -> there.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Perubahan Tenses dalam Kalimat Tidak Langsung (Reported Speech)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk kalimat tidak langsung yang benar sesuai aturan pergeseran tenses (backshift).

questions.q: 1. Kalimat langsung: 'I am learning Spanish,' said Daniel. → Daniel said that he [BLANK] Spanish.
questions.hint: am learning (Present Cont.) bergeser menjadi was learning (Past Cont.)
questions.explanation: Present Continuous bergeser menjadi Past Continuous dalam Reported Speech.

questions.q: 2. Kalimat langsung: 'We live in Manchester,' they told me. → They told me that they [BLANK] in Manchester.
questions.hint: live (Present Simple) bergeser menjadi lived (Past Simple)
questions.explanation: Present Simple berubah menjadi Past Simple.

questions.q: 3. Kalimat langsung: 'I will call you tomorrow,' promised Kevin. → Kevin promised that he [BLANK] call me the next day.
questions.explanation: Kata bantu 'will' berubah menjadi 'would'.

questions.q: 4. Kalimat langsung: 'I have finished my project,' said Lisa. → Lisa said that she [BLANK] her project.
questions.hint: have finished (Present Perfect) bergeser menjadi had finished (Past Perfect)
questions.explanation: Present Perfect bergeser menjadi Past Perfect ('had finished').

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Membedakan said (that) vs told me/him/her
exercises.instruction: Ketik said atau told pada bagian yang kosong.

questions.q: 1. She [BLANK] that she was too tired to go out.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'said' saat tidak diikuti langsung oleh objek pendengar.

questions.q: 2. He [BLANK] me the surprising news yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'told' jika langsung diikuti oleh objek orang ('told me').

questions.q: 3. The teacher [BLANK] the students to open their books.
questions.explanation: 'told + someone + to do something'.

questions.q: 4. Oliver [BLANK] that he would help us with the preparations.
questions.explanation: Oliver said that...

grammar.summary: 'used to' digunakan untuk menyatakan kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lalu yang sekarang sudah tidak dilakukan atau tidak benar lagi.

tables.title: Rumus used to
rows: I used to live in a small village.
He didn't use to like vegetables.
Did you use to play basketball?

rules: Pada kalimat negatif dan tanya, gunakan 'use to' (tanpa akhiran -d) karena sudah ada kata bantu 'did/didn't'.
'used to' HANYA ada dalam bentuk lampau. Untuk kebiasaan masa sekarang, gunakan Simple Present tense biasa dengan adverb of frequency (usually, always).

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kebiasaan Masa Lalu dengan used to
exercises.instruction: Lengkapi kalimat dengan used to atau didn't use to dan kata kerja yang sesuai.

questions.q: 1. When I was a child, I [BLANK] (play) outdoors with my friends every afternoon.
questions.explanation: Menyatakan kebiasaan masa lalu yang sudah tidak dilakukan lagi: 'used to play'.

questions.q: 2. She [BLANK] (not like) vegetables when she was younger, but now she loves salad.
questions.explanation: Bentuk negatif: 'didn't use to' (kata 'use' kembali ke bentuk dasar tanpa 'd').

questions.q: 3. [BLANK] (you / have) long hair when you were at school?
questions.explanation: Pola kalimat tanya: 'Did + subjek + use to + kata kerja dasar'.

questions.q: 4. There [BLANK] (be) a quiet park here before they built the shopping mall.
questions.explanation: Menyatakan keberadaan di masa lalu: 'There used to be'.

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Perubahan Kota Dulu dan Sekarang (Audio TR 25 & Gambar)
exercises.instruction: Amati gambar dan dengarkan rekaman audio TR 25, lalu lengkapi paragraf tentang kota yang dulu tenang dan kini berubah ramai.

questions.q: 1. My town has grown (1) [BLANK] a bit since I've been living here.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 25: 'My town has grown quite a bit...'

questions.q: 2. It used to be a (2) [BLANK] town; everyone used to (3) [BLANK2] each other.
questions.hint: Dulu kota tenang dan saling mengenal
questions.explanation: Audio TR 25: 'It used to be a quiet town; everyone used to know each other...'

questions.q: 3. There didn't use to be any air (4) [BLANK] either; now there is.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 25: 'There didn't use to be any air pollution either...'

questions.q: 4. There used to be small market stalls selling food. Now there is a big (5) [BLANK].
questions.explanation: Audio TR 25: 'Now there is a big supermarket.'

questions.q: 5. The people are always in a (6) [BLANK] nowadays and they never have time to stop and chat.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 25: 'The people are always in a hurry nowadays...'

grammar.summary: Cara mengekspresikan persetujuan (So do I / Neither do I) atau ketidaksetujuan secara wajar dalam percakapan sehari-hari.
rules: Gunakan 'So + auxiliary + subject' untuk menyetujui pernyataan positif.
Gunakan 'Neither + auxiliary + subject' untuk menyetujui pernyataan negatif.
Auxiliary (kata bantu) harus cocok dengan tenses kalimat pertama (do/does, am/is/are, can, have, did).

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Persetujuan Positif (So do I / So am I / So can I / So have I)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah ungkapan persetujuan yang benar sesuai kata kerja bantu kalimat afirmatif.

questions.q: 1. A: I love listening to classical music. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Untuk kata kerja Present Simple biasa (love), gunakan 'So do I.'

questions.q: 2. A: I am really tired after the long journey. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Untuk to be 'am', respon persetujuan adalah 'So am I.'

questions.q: 3. A: I can speak three languages fluently. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Untuk modal 'can', respon persetujuan adalah 'So can I.'

questions.q: 4. A: I have visited Paris twice. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Untuk kata bantu 'have', respon persetujuan adalah 'So have I.'

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Persetujuan Negatif (Neither do I / Neither am I / Neither can I)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah respon persetujuan atas pernyataan bernada negatif.

questions.q: 1. A: I don't like horror movies. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Neither do I' untuk menyetujui pernyataan negatif berpredikat don't.

questions.q: 2. A: I'm not ready for the exam yet. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Neither am I' untuk menyetujui pernyataan to be negatif.

questions.q: 3. A: I can't swim very well. → B: [BLANK]
questions.explanation: Respon persetujuan negatif untuk modal 'can't' adalah 'Neither can I.'

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Merespon Pernyataan Rekaman Audio TR 26
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan pernyataan pada audio TR 26, lalu pasangkan respon persetujuan atau ketidaksetujuan yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Audio: 'Megan must work harder.' → Respon persetujuan:
questions.explanation: Menyetujui keharusan: 'So must we.'

questions.q: 2. Audio: 'They never do any homework in class.' → Respon persetujuan (kalimat bernada negatif karena ada kata never):
questions.explanation: Kata 'never' membuat kalimat bernada negatif sehingga dijawab dengan 'Neither do we.'

questions.q: 3. Audio: 'I've been to Japan.' → Respon persetujuan:
questions.explanation: Respon persetujuan Present Perfect: 'So have I.'

questions.q: 4. Audio: 'She wasn't here yesterday.' → Respon persetujuan:
questions.explanation: Respon persetujuan to be lampau negatif: 'Neither was I.'

grammar.summary: Question tag adalah pertanyaan pendek di ujung kalimat yang dipakai untuk meminta konfirmasi atau persetujuan lawan bicara.

tables.title: Pola Question Tag
rows: You are a student, aren't you?
She can speak Spanish, can't she?

rules: Kasus khusus: 'I am right, aren't I?'
Kalimat ajakan: 'Let's go, shall we?'
Perintah: 'Open the window, will you?'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Melengkapi Question Tags (Pernyataan Positif & Negatif)
exercises.instruction: Ketik question tag yang tepat (misal: isn't he, do they, can you, aren't you) pada bagian yang kosong.

questions.q: 1. You are from London, [BLANK]?
questions.hint: Pernyataan positif (+ are) -> tag negatif (- aren't you)
questions.explanation: Subjek 'you' dengan to be positif 'are' menghasilkan tag 'aren't you?'.

questions.q: 2. She doesn't speak Japanese, [BLANK]?
questions.hint: Pernyataan negatif (- doesn't) -> tag positif (+ does she)
questions.explanation: Kalimat negatif 'doesn't' menghasilkan tag positif 'does she?'.

questions.q: 3. They watched the film yesterday, [BLANK]?
questions.hint: Past Simple positif (+ watched) -> tag negatif (- didn't they)
questions.explanation: Bentuk lampau positif 'watched' memakai tag 'didn't they?'.

questions.q: 4. He can play the piano very well, [BLANK]?
questions.hint: Modal positif can -> tag negatif can't he
questions.explanation: Modal 'can' menghasilkan tag 'can't he?'.

questions.q: 5. We haven't met before, [BLANK]?
questions.hint: Negatif haven't -> tag positif have we
questions.explanation: Kalimat negatif 'haven't' menghasilkan tag positif 'have we?'.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Pertanyaan Penegas Question Tags dalam Dialog (Audio TR 27)
exercises.instruction: Dengarkan percakapan konfirmasi pada audio TR 27, lalu pilih tag pertanyaan dan jawaban singkat yang sesuai.

questions.q: 1. A: Louise needs a new mobile phone, [BLANK]? B: Yes, she does.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 27 nomor 1: 'Louise needs a new mobile phone, doesn't she?'

questions.q: 2. A: Mark can't drive yet, [BLANK]? B: No, he can't.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 27 nomor 2: 'Mark can't drive yet, can he?'

questions.q: 3. A: The post office is next to the bank in town, [BLANK]? B: Yes, it is.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 27 nomor 4: 'The post office is next to the bank in town, isn't it?'

questions.q: 4. A: Simon hasn't got any pets, [BLANK]? B: No, he hasn't.
questions.explanation: Audio TR 27 nomor 5: 'Simon hasn't got any pets, has he?'

units.title: Bentuk pasif (Passive Voice)
units.english_title: Passive Voice: Present and Past Passive

grammar.summary: Kalimat pasif digunakan ketika fokus perhatian tertuju pada objek/tindakan, bukan pada siapa yang melakukan tindakan tersebut.

tables.title: Rumus Kalimat Pasif
rows: Millions of emails are sent every day.
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.

rules: Pelaku tindakan (agent) diperkenalkan dengan kata depan 'by': 'written by Sarah Jane Lewis'.
Jika pelaku tidak diketahui, tidak penting, atau sudah jelas, 'by ...' tidak perlu disebutkan.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kalimat Pasif Waktu Sekarang (Present Simple Passive: is/are + V3)
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk kalimat pasif yang tepat (is / are + kata kerja ketiga V3).

questions.q: 1. Millions of emails [BLANK] (send) around the world every single day.
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'emails' menggunakan 'are' + V3 'sent'.

questions.q: 2. Coffee [BLANK] (grow) in tropical countries like Brazil and Indonesia.
questions.explanation: Benda tak terhitung 'coffee' diperlakukan tunggal: 'is grown'.

questions.q: 3. English [BLANK] (speak) by people in many international conferences.
questions.explanation: 'English' adalah subjek tunggal: 'is spoken'.

questions.q: 4. The classrooms [BLANK] (clean) by the janitors every evening.
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'classrooms' menggunakan 'are cleaned'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Kalimat Pasif Waktu Lampau (Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk pasif lampau yang tepat sesuai subjek dan peristiwa sejarah.

questions.q: 1. The telephone [BLANK] by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.
questions.explanation: 'The telephone' adalah subjek tunggal di masa lampau: 'was invented'.

questions.q: 2. The ancient pyramids in Egypt [BLANK] thousands of years ago.
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'The pyramids' menggunakan 'were built'.

questions.q: 3. The masterpiece Mona Lisa [BLANK] by Leonardo da Vinci.
questions.explanation: Lukisan tunggal 'Mona Lisa' menggunakan 'was painted'.

units.title: Kata kerja indrawi (Sense Verbs)
units.english_title: Sense Verbs: look, sound, smell, taste, feel

grammar.summary: Kata kerja indrawi (verbs of perception) menggambarkan apa yang dilihat, didengar, dibaui, dirasakan lidah, atau dirasakan tubuh.

tables.title: Pola Sense Verbs
rows: You look tired. This soup smells delicious.
It sounds like thunder. It tastes like strawberry.

rules: Sense verbs diikuti KATA SIFAT (adjective), BUKAN kata keterangan (adverb): 'You look happy' (BUKAN 'happily').
Gunakan 'like' jika setelahnya adalah kata benda: 'That sounds like a good idea.'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Kata Kerja Indrawi (look, sound, smell, taste, feel + Adjective)
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah kata kerja indrawi yang paling tepat sesuai fungsi panca indra.

questions.q: 1. Mmm! Those chocolate cookies [BLANK] delicious! Can I try one?
questions.explanation: Indra penciuman untuk aroma lezat memakai 'smell delicious'.

questions.q: 2. Listen to this new song! It [BLANK] fantastic.
questions.explanation: Indra pendengaran (musik/suara) memakai 'sounds fantastic'.

questions.q: 3. Touch this silk scarf. It [BLANK] very soft and smooth.
questions.explanation: Indra peraba untuk tekstur kain menggunakan 'feels soft'.

questions.q: 4. This soup [BLANK] a bit too salty. Did you put too much salt in it?
questions.explanation: Indra pengecap lidah memakai 'tastes salty'.

questions.q: 5. You [BLANK] very tired today. Did you stay up late last night?
questions.explanation: Tampilan visual seseorang memakai 'look tired'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Penggunaan like setelah Kata Kerja Indrawi (look like, sound like, taste like)
exercises.instruction: Ketik bentuk 'verb + like' yang sesuai (misal: sounds like, looks like, tastes like) sebelum kata benda.

questions.q: 1. That cloud [BLANK] (look) a giant fluffy rabbit!
questions.hint: look like + kata benda (a giant rabbit)
questions.explanation: Jika diikuti kata benda, tambahkan 'like': 'looks like a giant fluffy rabbit'.

questions.q: 2. That guitar riff [BLANK] (sound) an old Beatles song.
questions.explanation: 'sounds like' digunakan saat membandingkan suara dengan suatu benda.

questions.q: 3. This exotic fruit [BLANK] (taste) a mix of strawberry and banana.
questions.explanation: 'tastes like' digunakan untuk membandingkan cita rasa dengan makanan lain.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 1 Ex 4: Possessions & Jobs
audio_transcripts.content:
Marsha's fifteen and lives in a big city. She's got a bright red moped and uses it everyday to go to school. She also uses it at weekends when she goes out with her friends. Her favourite sports are tennis and volleyball.

Nick's a farmer and lives in the country. He gets up at five o'clock in the morning to feed the animals, and then works in the fields. He works hard seven days a week but likes to go out with his wife to the cinema and go dancing at weekends.

Caroline's a history teacher at Hathaway High School. She loves her job and enjoys teaching children. In her free time, she gives students drama lessons. At the moment they're rehearsing for a play called 'Hamlet' by William Shakespeare. It's a difficult play but very interesting.

Sam's twenty-five years old and is a policeman. He lives and works in a small town in the UK. The people there are very friendly and his job isn't very stressful. He loves to go to football matches on Sundays and sometimes after work he rides his bike. He loves to travel and always visits places where he can relax. In his spare time he reads lots of books. His favourite are fantasy and adventure stories.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 3 Ex 5: Invitations & Suggestions
audio_transcripts.content:
1 Would you like to go to the cinema?
2 Let's have a picnic. It's a beautiful day.
3 What would you like to do at the weekend?
4 How about we go for coffee?
5 Why don't we go to the beach?
6 How would you like your steak cooked?

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 3 Ex 9: Janet & Laura Phone Call
audio_transcripts.content:
Janet: Hello.
Laura: Hi, Janet. It's Laura. How are you?
Janet: Fine, thanks.
Laura: Are you busy on Tuesday afternoon?
Janet: Mmm. Well, I usually do my homework. Why?
Laura: Would you like to come shopping with me?
Janet: What do you want to buy?
Laura: I'd like a new winter coat.
Janet: Where do you want to go?
Laura: I was thinking of going to the town centre.
Janet: OK. I'd love to come.
Laura: Great!
Janet: What time do you think we'll be back?
Laura: I'm not sure. Maybe around six.
Janet: OK. I'll study when I get home then.
Laura: See you at school tomorrow.
Janet: Bye.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 3 Ex 10: Alice & Jason West End Show
audio_transcripts.content:
Alice: Hello.
Jason: Hi, Alice. It's Jason.
Alice: Hi, Jason. How are you?
Jason: Fine, thanks. Have you got any plans for Friday?
Alice: No, I haven't. Why?
Jason: I've got two tickets for that new West End show, Bright Lights. Would you like to come with me?
Alice: Wow! How did you get the tickets?
Jason: I waited in line for four hours!
Alice: Where shall we meet?
Jason: Let's meet in front of the art gallery at 3 o'clock.
Alice: OK. After the show we can get something to eat. Do you like pizza?
Alice: Yes, I love it. It's my favourite food. I'll see you on Friday.
Jason: Bye!
Alice: See you!

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 4 Ex 5: Future Plans with Pictures
audio_transcripts.content:
1 She's going to cut her hair.
2 He's going to take the dog for a walk.
3 They're going to have a lesson.
4 It's going to rain.
5 They're going to ride their bikes.
6 He's going to travel by plane.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 5 Ex 4: Reflexive Pronouns
audio_transcripts.content:
1 Tony cut himself with the scissors.
2 Don't worry about them. They can take care of themselves.
3 The girl was lucky when she fell off her bike that she didn't badly hurt herself.
4 Be careful! The oven is on. Don't burn yourself.
5 William and Jeff climbed to the top of the mountain by themselves.
6 They accidently left their keys in the car so they couldn't open it. They locked themselves out by mistake.
7 It's not our fault. We shouldn't blame ourselves.
8 I'm such a fool! I could kick myself!
9 The exhibition was great. We really enjoyed ourselves.
10 I don't want you to pay for me. I'll pay for myself.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 6 Ex 2: Uses of to get
audio_transcripts.content:
1 A: We're getting old. B: Oh, don't say that!
2 A: It's getting busy in this café. B: Let's go outside.
3 A: I'm getting bored of doing my homework. B: Why don't you take a break?
4 A: The baby's getting tired. B: Why don't you put him to bed?
5 A: I'm ready to go out. B: Where are you going?
6 A: This exercise is getting difficult. B: Why don't you ask for help?
7 A: It's getting late. B: Let's hurry up.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 7 Ex 3: Polite Requests with could
audio_transcripts.content:
Conversation 1:
Terry: Hi, Diane. Why weren't you at school today?
Diane: I'm sick. I have the flu. Could you tell me if we have any homework for next week?
Terry: Yes, there's going to be a Maths test on Tuesday and an English test on Thursday.
Diane: Oh, thanks. Anything else?
Terry: No. But I hope you get better soon.
Diane: Thanks!

Conversation 2:
Anne: Hello Jack! You're back early.
Jack: Oh hi, Anne. Yes, I didn't have any lectures this afternoon at university.
Anne: That's good. Actually, I'm glad I caught you.
Jack: Oh yes, Why's that?
Anne: Could you do me a favour, please? I have an English class this evening but my car is being fixed in the garage. Could you drive me to class?
Jack: Yes, of course! What time's your class?
Anne: It's from 7:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m.
Jack: OK, no problem. What time do you want to leave?
Anne: Well, I have some coursework to finish this afternoon, so could we leave here at around 7 p.m.?
Jack: Yes, okay. Would you like me to come and pick you up as well?
Anne: No, that's fine. A few classmates and I are going to get something to eat after the class.
Jack: OK, cool. Well, knock on my room door when you're ready to leave.
Anne: Great! Thanks, Jack. See you later.
Jack: Bye!

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 7 Ex 6: Directions in Chicago with could
audio_transcripts.content:
Ursula: Excuse me, officer, could you help me?
Policeman: Yes, Madam. What's the problem?
Ursula: I think I'm lost. I'm looking for the Central Train Station but I've been walking for thirty minutes and I still haven't found it.
Policeman: Well, you're in the right direction. Continue down this street past the traffic light. Turn right on Churchill Road. Go past the post office and Jefferson's Groceries. Turn left on South Street and walk for about 150 yards. You will see the station on your right.
Ursula: Is it far?
Policeman: Oh, not too far. It's about fifteen minutes from here on foot.
Ursula: Fifteen minutes? Ah, my suitcase is so heavy. Is there a bus that stops there?
Policeman: Yes, there is. Bus H stops in front of the train station. The bus stop is on the corner of Park Avenue and 7th Street. You can buy a ticket at the newsstand across the street.
Ursula: How long will it take by bus?
Policeman: Well, there's no traffic at this hour. It'll take about six minutes.
Ursula: How will I know when to get off?
Policeman: You can ask the bus driver but don't worry; the Central Station is very big. You can't miss it!

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 9 Ex 6: Indefinite Pronouns Story
audio_transcripts.content: It was a rainy, grey Saturday afternoon when someone knocked at my door. 'Who's there?' I asked. But no one answered. So I slowly opened the door to see if somebody was waiting. But there wasn't anybody in sight. Suddenly, I heard something make a noise. I looked down and saw a small, fluffy kitten stretching itself while it was looking up at me. 'It must be hungry, poor thing,' I thought. 'Let me get it something to eat.' And I went to the kitchen. When I came back five minutes later, the kitten wasn't there. 'It must be somewhere,' I thought, so I started looking for it. But I couldn't find it anywhere. It ran away.

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 10 Ex 6: Conversation about Work Obligations
audio_transcripts.content:
Sam: Hi, Tony. How are you?
Tony: I'm great! I've got a new job.
Sam: That's fantastic! What are you going to be doing?
Tony: I'm a product manager for a company that sells food.
Sam: What do you have to do?
Tony: Well, I have to contact the people who sell us their products and we have to agree on a price. Then these people have to send me their products and I have to send them to the supermarkets.
Sam: That sounds interesting. Is it a difficult job?
Tony: Well, sort of. I have to work long hours. I have to start work at five in the morning!
Sam: Wow! And what does your boss do?
Tony: He has to contact our international clients so he has to travel a lot. He has to travel to Ireland, Scotland and Wales next week.
Sam: Do you have to go with him?
Tony: No, I don't have to but I have to fill in for him in the office. I'm enjoying myself so far and I'm happy I don't have to work in that shop anymore!

audio_transcripts.title: Unit 11 Ex 7: Doctor Consultations
audio_transcripts.content:

Doctor: Do you exercise regularly?

Doctor: It looks like you're a little overweight, too. Am I right?

Doctor: You should go on a diet.
Mr Kane: A diet?
Doctor: Yes. What do you usually eat?
Mr Kane: I love burgers and pizza. I also like take-away food.
Doctor: You shouldn't eat that kind of food. You should eat lots of fruit and vegetables.
Mr Kane: Anything else?
Doctor: You should start exercising twice a week. Come see me again next month.
Mr Kane: OK. Thanks for your advice.

Dialogue 3:
Doctor: Hi, Janet. What's the problem?
Janet: I can't sleep at night.
Doctor: Since when?
Janet: Since about ten days now.
Doctor: What are you doing differently in your life recently?
Janet: Well, I moved house about a month ago. And I'm busy trying to organise everything.
Doctor: By yourself?
Janet: Yes.
Doctor: You should get somebody to help you.
Janet: I guess you're right.
Doctor: And you shouldn't work until late. You should stop and have dinner and then you should relax.
Janet: But there are so many things to do.
Doctor: You shouldn't be anxious. Take your time and you'll get everything done.
Janet: Thanks Dr Jefferson.
